ionlosangeles.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Criminal Hatred
ionlosangeles.us.description: The detectives go undercover to arrest a man who brutally attacks other men; a deceptively tough defense attorney (Nia Vardalos) complicates ADA Barba's case. (Drama)

ionlosangeles.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Monster's Legacy
ionlosangeles.us.description: When a janitor violently attacks a coach, the SVU team connects the janitor's behavior to a history of sexual abuse; the detectives find more victims of the same predator -- including a prisoner (Mike Tyson) on death row. (Drama)

ionlosangeles.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Secrets Exhumed
ionlosangeles.us.description: FBI Agent Dana Lewis partners with SVU when she thinks a 25-year-old rape-murder case in New York is connected to multiple unsolved cases across the country; as Lewis doggedly pursues her suspect, Benson and Amaro question his guilt. (Drama)

ionlosangeles.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Deadly Ambition
ionlosangeles.us.description: The SVU squad tries to keep Detective Rollins' sister safe from her abusive boyfriend when she turns up beaten and pregnant; when Rollins is forced to take drastic action, internal affairs investigation begins. (Drama)

ionlosangeles.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Funny Valentine
ionlosangeles.us.description: A promising singer is beaten by her boyfriend, a famous hip-hop star, but she refuses to help ADA Barba build his case; the defendant and his attorney turn the case into a media circus. (Drama)

ionlosangeles.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Undercover Blue
ionlosangeles.us.description: A woman claims that Brian Cassidy (Dean Winters) raped her while he was working undercover; when Cassidy and his lawyer utilize surprising defense methods, Detective Amaro is affected. (Drama)

ionlosangeles.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Legitimate Rape
ionlosangeles.us.description: A popular sports reporter (Lauren Cohan) accuses a cameraman (David Marciano) of rape and stalking; when the victim learns she is pregnant as a result of the rape, the defense employs controversial tactics in hope of gaining favor with the jury. (Drama)

ionlosangeles.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Born Psychopath
ionlosangeles.us.description: The SVU detectives investigate after a school nurse notices multiple injuries on a young girl; Detective Amaro tries to bond with his recently discovered son. (Drama)

ionlosangeles.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Girl Dishonored
ionlosangeles.us.description: As the SVU detectives investigate the alleged rape of a sorority pledge, drunken students and conflicting accounts complicate matters. (Drama)

ionlosangeles.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Traumatic Wound
ionlosangeles.us.description: When a concert turns into a mob scene, a teenager is brutally assaulted; Detective Amaro ends up defending the prime suspect's reputation. (Drama)

ionlosangeles.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Poisoned Motive
ionlosangeles.us.description: When two sniper attacks on the NYPD link to Detective Tutuola's past as a narcotics officer, he reconnects with his former partner in hope of finding a motive; Lt. Alexandra Eames helps SVU investigate. (Drama)

ionlosangeles.us.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit - Brief Interlude
ionlosangeles.us.description: The investigation into how a comatose woman ended up in a river near the mayor's home reveals the victim's unexpected wild side. (Drama)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E13 Winter Salads Jamie is nearly knocked off his feet in this episode as he braves the gales to collect a variety of salad.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E20 The Italian Products Have Arrived! The arrival of Italians into America demanded the need for Italian products as well. This resulted in more creativity and flavour in the kitchen like Belgian and red endive salads and cherry jam tarts.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E4 Spain Will travels to the land of Don Quixote to look at Manchego cheese before heading for the annual cheese fair at the medieval city of Trujillo and looking at cheese made from Merino ewes milk.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: What Chefs Want
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Sustainability Sustainability meets gastronomy, where Chef Matteo Ponti shares his passion for eco-friendly cooking. Sally discovers city farming at the Arden Food Forest, and explores the sustainable fish farming.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Bordighera One of the Riviera's most iconic seaside resorts, Bordighera captivates with its timeless charm.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice Of Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E10 The Importance Of Cheese Sophie visits a local cheese maker to see how they age their cheeses in caves and stuffs courgette flowers with local ricotta. She is also shown how to make the cakes known locally as nun's breasts.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E2 Neville Poelina: Orange Duck & Curry Bush Turkey Neville Poelina will show us how to make two delicious dishes with duck and bush turkey - making the most out of his outdoor forty-four gallon homemade bush oven.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E11 Cooking With Kids School Holidays mean finding things for the kids to do and Maggie and Simon get some kids busy looking for mushrooms and picking plums. Simon also visits a Mussel farm in Port Lincoln.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E25 Episode 25 Laura is joined by nutritionist Cassie Lawless to make delicious and healthy Thai Coconut Chicken Meatballs in the beautiful McLaren Vale region of South Australia.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E25 Getting Figgy With It: Chicken And Fig Rachael is joined by her husband, John, and her sister, Maria, as she shows how to prepare a Chicken and Fig dish featured on their wedding menu.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn Bbq
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Manly Dam Manly Dam is one of Hayden's favourite spots for a BBQ, and Hayden cooks up a storm with dishes featuring chicken drumsticks, wood-roasted salmon, and leg of lamb.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E3 Stephen Colbert And Evie McGee-Colbert The amazing talk show host, comedian, writer and producer Stephen Colbert and his wife, Producer Evie McGee Colbert are joining Ina for a wonderful day at the barn.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E20 Episode 20 Laura has an early start in the market as she makes her cheesy Chorizo Lasagne, before she assembles the go-to dish when you need to clean out your fridge, her delicious Frittata.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia In Vietnam
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Con Dao, Phu Quoc And Bac Lieu Luke gets up early on two of Vietnam's southern islands to learn about sea turtle conservation and join the local fishermen. In the Mekong Delta he visits a Vietnamese-Australian-run shrimp business.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E49 Episode 49 A guest vegan dessert, a twist on salad and a trip to Macao. This episode of Everyday Gourmet gives you a whole lot of foodie variety.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E82 Tomato Party You say tomato, Adam says tomato party. On the guest list: chef Shane Delia, Paralympic gold and silver medallist Vanessa Low OAM, and you!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Beyond Bali With Lara Lee
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 West Timor: New Connections And Family Ties In West Timor, Lara is reunited with her father's birthplace, meeting extended family, learning home-cooked recipes and deepening her connection to her Indonesian heritage.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: How Do They Really Do It?
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 : Domino's Domino's is the biggest name in the UK when it comes to the highly competitive pizza delivery business. Go inside the kitchens of this pizza empire to meet those involved first-hand.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Bamboo Shoots And Cured Ham Stir Fry All through Anhui, locals cure their own pork in winter, often simply hanging a piece of pork in the cold, dry air and salting it every week or so. The result is a favourite ingredient in Anhui’s simple stir-fried dishes.

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

bbcamerica.us.title: Misery
bbcamerica.us.description: After a serious car crash, novelist Paul Sheldon (James Caan) is rescued by former nurse Annie Wilkes (Kathy Bates), who claims to be his biggest fan. Annie brings him to her remote cabin to recover, where her obsession takes a dark turn when she discovers Sheldon is killing off her favorite character from his novels. As Sheldon devises plans for escape, Annie grows increasingly controlling, even violent, as she forces the author to shape his writing to suit her twisted fantasies. (Horror, Thriller) - 1990

bbcamerica.us.title: Christine
bbcamerica.us.description: Unpopular nerd Arnie Cunningham (Keith Gordon) buys a 1958 Plymouth Fury, which he names Christine. Arnie develops an unhealthy obsession with the car, to the alarm of his jock friend, Dennis Guilder (John Stockwell). After bully Buddy Repperton (William Ostrander) defaces Christine, the auto restores itself to perfect condition and begins killing off Buddy and his friends. Determined to stop the deaths, Dennis and Arnie's girlfriend, Leigh Cabot (Alexandra Paul), decide to destroy Christine. (Horror) - 1983

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

(Special, Documentary, Biography, Entertainment) - 2017-01-01

retroplex.us.title: McLintock!
retroplex.us.description: Aging rancher George Washington McLintock, a wealthy self-made man, is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men, McLintock's own sons and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife, who left him two years previously, suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in her husband -- she wants custody of their daughter. (Western, Comedy) - 1963

retroplex.us.title: The Red Stallion
retroplex.us.description: Elderly Aggie Curtis is in financial trouble and must come up with cash or sell the horse ranch she runs with her orphaned grandson, Joel. Hoping to save the ranch, Joel decides to train his favorite horse, a stallion named Red, to race. This proves to be no easy task, though -- while Red is speedy, he's also quite unruly. But the Curtises' wealthy neighbor, Moresby, takes an interest in buying Red, and Joel must consider selling his animal pal. (Adventure) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: Oklahoma Annie
retroplex.us.description: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day. (Western, Comedy) - 1952

retroplex.us.title: Border Badmen
retroplex.us.description: After the death of a rich and very distant cousin, bumbling cowboy Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) convinces his pal Billy (Buster Crabbe) to travel with him to the dead man's estate to try to claim the fortune. When they arrive, they meet Helen Stockton (Lorraine Miller), the rightful heir to the estate, but the cousin's scheming superintendent wants the inheritance for himself, so he sends his henchmen after Fuzzy, Billy and Helen. The trio must thwart the crooks and vie for the money. (Western) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: Kill Johnny Ringo
retroplex.us.description: Mysterious drifter Johnny Ringo arrives in a small town to put an end to a ruthless counterfeiting gang, facing danger and deception along the way. (Adventure, Western) - 1966

retroplex.us.title: 'Neath the Arizona Skies
retroplex.us.description: A cowboy escorts a young half-Native American girl, whose mother has recently died. He must find her white father in order to claim her hefty inheritance. (Western) - 1934

retroplex.us.title: Panhandle
retroplex.us.description: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Treasure of Ruby Hills
retroplex.us.description: Cattlemen Reynolds (Barton MacLane) and Payne (Charles Fredericks) use their influence to edge less powerful ranchers out of the bountiful Ruby Hills Valley, then set their sights on eliminating each another. While they're busy fighting over the land, the peace-minded Ross Haney (Zachary Scott) buys up all the water rights to the valley. But Haney's bid for order is disrupted by Doran (Dick Foran), a scheming third rancher, who supplies the warring parties with deadly gunfighters. (Western) - 1955

retroplex.us.title: Oklahoma Annie
retroplex.us.description: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day. (Western, Comedy) - 1952

retroplex.us.title: Susanna Pass
retroplex.us.description: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Little Big Horn
retroplex.us.description: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor). (Historical drama) - 1951

retroplex.us.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
retroplex.us.description: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Brother Outlaw
retroplex.us.description: A man is framed for bank robbery, prompting his brother to spring him from jail. Their search for the real culprits ends in a violent confrontation with a famed gunfighter. (Western) - 1971

retroplex.us.title: Sitting Bull
retroplex.us.description: Recognizing that Maj. Robert Parrish (Dale Robertson) has a history of making peace with Native American tribes, President Ulysses S. Grant (John Hamilton) sends him to iron out a land dispute with Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish). Though negotiations seem to be going well, Parrish can't stop the deadly Battle of Little Big Horn. Many die, but when he helps Sitting Bull survive, Parrish is charged with crimes against the government, and he will be executed unless Grant steps in. (Western) - 1954

backstage.us.title: Brooklyn's Finest
backstage.us.description: A drug operation changes the lives of three conflicted New York cops. Burned-out vet Eddie Dugan is close to retirement; narcotics cop Sal Procida faces the difficult task of caring for his large family on his ordinary salary. Undercover officer Clarence Tango Butler finds his loyalties beginning to shift toward a powerful drug dealer. Over seven chaotic days, the three men are drawn toward a fateful crime and destiny. (Crime drama) - 2009

backstage.us.title: City of Lies
backstage.us.description: Los Angeles Police Department detective Russell Poole has spent years trying to solve his biggest case -- the murders of The Notorious B.I.G. and Tupac Shakur -- but after two decades, the investigation remains open. Jack Jackson, a reporter desperate to save his reputation and career, is determined to find out why. In search of the truth, the two team up and unravel a growing web of institutional corruption and lies. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 2018

backstage.us.title: Lord of War
backstage.us.description: The 20-year arms dealing career of Queens, N.Y., outcast Yuri Orlov (Nicolas Cage) serves as a window onto the end of the Cold War and the emergence of worldwide terrorism. He finds himself reassuring his more ethically challenged younger brother, Vitaly (Jared Leto), while adeptly sidestepping the pursuit of federal agent Jack Lawrence (Ethan Hawke). The globetrotting arms dealer also pursues the woman of his dreams, supermodel Ava Fontaine (Bridget Moynahan). (Drama, Action) - 2005

backstage.us.title: The Boondock Saints
backstage.us.description: Tired of the crime overrunning the streets of Boston, Irish Catholic twin brothers Conner (Sean Patrick Flanery) and Murphy (Norman Reedus) are inspired by their faith to cleanse their hometown of evil with their own brand of zealous vigilante justice. As they hunt down and kill one notorious gangster after another, they become controversial folk heroes in the community. But Paul Smecker (Willem Dafoe), an eccentric FBI agent, is fast closing in on their blood-soaked trail. (Crime drama, Thriller, Action, Dark comedy) - 1999

arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E14 The Suzanne Gets One-Upped Episode Nick plans a surprise belated honeymoon and uses work to cover up his plans.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E11 My First Job Episode Lindsey learns about stealing at the workplace when she lands her first job and gives out free food.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E20 The Quarantine Episode When Marilyn brings a dangerous flu back from a trip to Mexico, the family must stay inside their house under quarantine.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E33 The Pocket Dial Episode After Nick gets pocket-dialed by Suzanne and overhears her telling Gigi something personal, he gets back at Suzanne by fake pocketing dialling her.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E01 The Hyphenated Name Episode Nick and Suzanne have been married for about six months, and the new blended family is beginning to experience growing pains; Suzanne decides to hyphenate her name; Nick thinks the kids do not love him and will not accept him.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E40 The Thanksgiving Episode The entire Kingston-Persons clan is at the house for a pot-luck Thanksgiving, but Suzanne's forgotten one thing, the turkey.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E29 The Fight Party Episode Nick's boxing match party unexpectedly takes over the family room on the same night Suzanne's book group is meeting in the living room.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E05 The Cooking Episode Nick and Suzanne go head-to-head in the kitchen when Nick says cooking is easy and Suzanne challenges him to a family cooking competition.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E32 The Suzanne's Surprise Party Episode Nick and the kids throw a birthday party for Suzanne because she has never had one.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E23 The Career Day Episode Nick confuses Kevin's classmates when he implies that networking is more important than studying and getting good grades.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E20 The Salsa Episode Annoyed that she and Nick never do anything together as a couple, Suzanne signs the two of them up for salsa lessons, but is surprised by her control issues on the dance floor.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E09 The Green Episode The family decides to go green, but it is much harder than they thought, and they realize sometimes you have to choose between saving the planet and saving your family.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E16 The Ghost Dog Episode The entire family plays pranks on one another, to the chagrin of Suzanne; when the family ignores Nick's choking because they think it's another prank, Nick has a near-death experience and embraces his Zen side.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E02 The We Ain't Going Out Like That Episode Nick tries to be spontaneous; Suzanne resists and plans a date night that fails; they attempt to be spontaneous together until they realize it's better if she plans.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E07 The Suzanne Theft Auto Episode Suzanne becomes overly consumed with Kevin's science project; Lindsey revs up for driving lessons, only to emerge as a suspect when her mother's car is scratched.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E08 The Second Black President Episode Kevin is torn between running a clean campaign for class president and being negative about his opponent.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E31 The Kevin Gets a Commercial Episode Kevin auditions for a commercial for the mall burger joint and ends up being replaced by a famous kid actor that looks just like him.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E46 The Black Friday Episode Comical chaos ensues when the gang waits in line to shop at a department store on Black Friday. Kevin anticipates buying a new video game, Lindsey meets a boy, relationship problems plague Martin and Terrence hopes to buy toys for charity.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E12 The Parent Teacher Trap Episode When Suzanne gets roped into a committee at Kevin's school, where the other mums are mean to her, Nick volunteers to fill in on her behalf, making things awkward when the ladies love him.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E09 The She Got Game Night Episode When the Kingston-Persons decide to have a game night, all bets are off, as unlikely friends are drawn to one another when paired together for games.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E33 The Mother's Day Episode Nick tricks Suzanne and Marilyn into spending a weekend together at a spa for Mother's Day, where it becomes clear it will take more than a masseuse to relieve the tension in the women's relationship.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E02 The Credit Check Episode Nick needs a new van for work, but Suzanne worries they are already too much in debt and cannot afford to buy a new one; Suzanne has some credit issues she has not revealed to Nick.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E03 The Oh No She Di-in't Episode When Nick's new field producer, Sam, turns out to be female, Suzanne is convinced she is trying to steal her man, a suggestion Nick thinks is absurd until Sam actually makes a move on him.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E53 The Good Day Seattle Episode The station launches a new morning show, but Nick's cohost is a self-serving reality star; Marilyn moves in with the family.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E08 The Michelle Obama Sweater Episode Using her mother's credit card, Lindsey gets help from Nick in ordering a Michelle Obama sweater online; Kevin pretends to be sick to pull off a scam to get a signed A-Rod jersey.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E12 The Tiger Dad Episode Nick becomes a more influential parent, so he pushes Kevin and Lindsey hard, and they become model children.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E28 The Nick Hosts a Telethon Episode Despite warnings from other co-workers, Nick gets stuck hosting a charity telethon; Suzanne has to deal with a rich client's boring wedding plans.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E10 The Despicable E Episode Lindsey's romantic attentions turn to a young celebrity DJ, who only neglects her in return; Suzanne teaches Kevin the art of doing laundry.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E06 The Booty Episode Nick goes to watch a game with friends at a sports bar known to have sexy female waitresses; the kids want a larger allowance, but they're not willing to do more chores.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E15 The First .45 Episode When Lindsay tries to turn family members into stars of a reality television show, Kevin makes a discovery that brings too much reality to the Kingston-Persons household.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E04 The Soccer Episode Kevin is a big football fan, but Nick does not understand the appeal; Suzanne is frustrated by Lindsey's lack of communication and creates a fake Facebook account to learn what is going on.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E35 The Life Insurance Episode Although Nick and Suzanne realize that life insurance would be a good decision to protect their family, Nick has reservations about buying a policy.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E07 The Viral Video Episode Suzanne gets caught dancing on a video that soon becomes a huge viral hit; Marilyn decides Lindsey needs to learn how to cook soul food.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E36 The Hypertension Episode When Nick gets a doctor's report that he has high blood pressure, Suzanne does everything she can to make sure his stress levels stay low.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E25 The Mr. Almost Episode When Nick happens upon an old college pal, the unexpected meeting gives rise to a business plan that involves a sports star and an energy drink; the results are not so bubbly.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E28 The Liar, Liar Episode Suzanne begins to force everyone in the family to tell the truth at all times after she catches Nick in a lie.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E34 The Secret Episode Lindsey has a new crush and Gigi has a new boyfriend, but when certain secrets cannot be kept, a web of misinformation nearly ruins both situations.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E17 The Lemon Squeeze Episode When the family's morning routine devolves into fighting, Gigi suggests that they try an old sorority exercise called the Lemon Squeeze in order to turn their problems around.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E31 The Kwandanegaba Children's Fund Episode Nick wants Lindsey and Kevin to give back to the community, so they select a charity they find online; when the charity keeps asking for more money, Nick has to get to the bottom of it.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E21 The V.I.P. Tickets Episode Suzanne is furious when Nick invites Martin and not her to a baseball game; Kevin and Lindsey try to win tickets to Rihanna's Los Angeles concert.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E01 The Staycation Episode When Nick messes up Suzanne's plans for spring break, he turns the house into a makeshift resort, and promises to give the family the best vacation ever.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S07 E19 The Exorcism of Stassi Schroeder Tom Schwartz finds a way to make good on his financial obligation to Lisa; Stassi visits a witch to exorcise the demons threatening her relationship; Lala stages a musical performance; Jax reveals some troubling issues during couple's therapy.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S07 E20 Brittany and the Beast Scheana goes out with a model in an attempt to make Adam jealous; James accuses Lala of being insincere; Brittany's big Kentucky family descends on West Hollywood in preparation for the engagement party; Jax puts his foot in his mouth.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S07 E21 Rules of Engagement Jax and Brittany celebrate their engagement at a fairytale-themed party; Ariana confronts Lisa Vanderpump; Brittany must inform Lala that she's excluded from her wedding party; Scheana reveals she's been with another guy.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S08 E01 There Goes the Neighborhood Jax, Brittany, Schwartz, Katie, Sandoval, and Ariana move into grown-up houses; Stassi tries to repair her friendship with Kristen; Lala confides in Lisa Vanderpump; Max dates the new hostess, Dayna; Tom Sandoval skips one of Jax's wedding events.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S08 E02 Training days When new server Dayna starts dating Max, Scheana makes Dayna's life difficult; Stassi, Katie and Brittany are bothered by Kristen's ties to Carter; Jax un-invites Carter from the trip to Miami; Lala and James come to terms; Ariana opens up to Lisa.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S08 E03 Next Level Rage Texts Stassi throws a book party at TomTom but excludes Tom Sandoval from the planning; Sandoval rage texts her, leading to an epic explosion between them and forcing Tom Schwartz to pick sides; Scheana bonds with Charli over their mutual dislike of Dayna.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S08 E04 Don't Do It, Brittany When the group heads to Miami, Beau confronts Sandoval for attacking Stassi at her book signing; Ariana accuses Schwartz of not pulling his weight at TomTom; Brittany has a meltdown triggered by an unexpected reminder of Jax's infidelity.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S08 E05 Grumpy Old Men Jax and Brittany's dual bachelor/bachelorette trip charges on as Sandoval, Schwartz, Jax, and Beau plan a surprise disguise for the girls, while Stassi finds herself caught in the middle of a friendship-ending fight between Katie and Kristen.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S08 E06 Your Pride's Showing Schwartz and Sandoval prepare for TomTom's first Gay Pride celebration, but their choice to hire James as DJ backfires when he gets Raquel in trouble at SUR and Lisa thinks he's drinking again.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S08 E07 It's Not About the Pastor Stassi, Katie and Lala throw Brittany a princess-themed bridal shower, while James gets disinvited from Peter's birthday party and Lisa takes Raquel to task for walking out on her shift during Pride.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S08 E08 Ex-Best Man, Ex-Best Friend Jax kicks Sandoval out of his wedding party and may disinvite him from Kentucky altogether.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S08 E09 If You're Going to Drink, I Can't Stop You With the wedding just days away, Jax must choose whether to forgive Tom, while Ariana struggles to find the excitement to attend her own birthday party; Katie and Kristen argue over whether Carter should go to the wedding.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S08 E10 Jax's Last Hurrah On the eve of Jax and Brittany's wedding, the rehearsal is disrupted when Stassi, Katie and Lala clash with Kristen; Jax tells a juicy secret about Katie and Schwartz's marriage.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S08 E11 Introducing Mr. and Mrs. Cauchi Jax and Brittany wed in a stylish Kentucky ceremony surrounded by friends, while Stassi wonders if Beau will ever propose to her; Lisa brings Katie and Schwartz to task for failing to make their marriage official.

bravovault.us.title: Vanderpump Rules
bravovault.us.description: S08 E12 All Daugs Go to Heaven Tom Sandoval throws an extra themed birthday party; Stassi and Katie learn they must work with Kristen; Max tries to ban Danica from TomTom; Tom Schwartz hosts an unusual memorial for his dead lizard, Daug.

cinevault.us.title: Finding Graceland
cinevault.us.description: En route to Memphis, Tenn., on a solemn solo road trip, widower Byron Gruman picks up a disarming hitchhiker who claims to be the late, great Elvis Presley. As Gruman opens up about the loss of his wife, Beatrice, in a tragic car accident, his bizarre passenger becomes a surprisingly powerful source of wisdom and comfort. The duo even picks up a Marilyn Monroe impersonator, Ashley, during the surreal pilgrimage to Graceland. (Drama, Movie) - 1998

cinevault.us.title: Hero
cinevault.us.description: Serial swindler Bernie Laplante (Dustin Hoffman) makes the first selfless gesture of his life when he helps save injured passengers from a roadside plane crash and then vanishes into the night. Hoping to find the hero who pulled her out of the wreck, reporter Gale Gayley (Geena Davis) announces a $1 million prize for stepping forward. But when handsome vagrant John Bubber (Andy Garcia) takes credit, Bernie struggles to expose him amid a media circus and countless adoring fans. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 1992-10-02

cinevault.us.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
cinevault.us.description: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Crime drama, Movie) - 2008-04-30

cinevault.us.title: A Fine Mess
cinevault.us.description: While at the racetrack, actor Spence (Ted Danson) overhears two mobsters plotting to fix a race by injecting a horse with steroids. When Spence and his friend Dennis (Howie Mandel) try to bet on the juiced horse, mob boss Tony Pazzo (Paul Sorvino) orders his goons to silence the duo forever. To make matters worse, Spence starts having an affair with Pazzo's wife, Claudia (Maria Conchita Alonso), and the police begin investigating recent events at the racetrack. (Comedy, Movie) - 1986-08-08

cinevault.us.title: Darkness Falls
cinevault.us.description: In Maine, the residents of Darkness Falls are all aware of the legend of Matilda Dixon, an old woman who was tragically murdered by a mob in the 1800s because the townspeople thought she was killing children. Now Darkness Falls has to contend with Matilda's supernatural wrath. Childhood friends Kyle (Chaney Kley) and Caitlin (Emma Caulfield) return home to uncover the truth behind the legend after Caitlin's little brother (Lee Cormie) has recurring nightmares about Matilda. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2003-01-24

cinevault.us.title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
cinevault.us.description: Bill Johnson leads a group of scientists into the jungles of Borneo. They are searching for the mythical black orchid, which can supposedly grant eternal life. Unfortunately, massive anacondas have been feeding on the orchids for years. When their boat goes over a waterfall, the scientists land right in the middle of the snakes' home. (Action, Adventure, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2004-08-27

cinevault.us.title: Red Water
cinevault.us.description: Former oil rig worker John Sanders (Lou Diamond Phillips) became a Louisiana fishing captain after a tragic accident ended his career. In need of money, he agrees to help his ex-wife, Kelli (Kristy Swanson), whose company is having trouble extracting oil upriver. Meanwhile, thugs working for a Jamaican gangster head to the same bayou searching for $3 million buried underwater. Both the scientists and the criminals are menaced by a man-eating shark that can survive in fresh water. (Movie, Thriller) - 2003-08-17

filmriseaction.us.title: Eye See You
filmriseaction.us.description: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one. (Thriller) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Assault on Precinct 13
filmriseaction.us.description: When the LAPD kills several members of the South Central gang Street Thunder, the remaining members avenge themselves by way of a bloody war waged against cops and citizens alike. Caught in the crossfire is Lt. Ethan Bishop (Austin Stoker), who's managing a skeleton crew at the local and soon-to-be-closed police precinct. As the gang members close in, Bishop forms an unlikely alliance with a group of prisoners in order to defend the station and the lives of everyone in it. (Action) - 1976

filmriseaction.us.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
filmriseaction.us.description: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men. (Thriller, Historical drama, War) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Castle Falls
filmriseaction.us.description: After decades of neglect, Castle Heights Hospital is packed with dynamite and ready to be demolished. However, no one knows that a gang leader, now in prison, hid $3 million in stolen cash inside the abandoned building. Now, three desperate parties want the money -- and they have exactly 90 minutes to find it and get out alive. (Action, Thriller) - 2021

filmriseaction.us.title: American Yakuza
filmriseaction.us.description: An undercover FBI agent has risen through the ranks of the Yakuza and now finds himself caught in a war between the Yakuza, the mob and the FBI. (Crime drama) - 1993

filmriseaction.us.title: Code Name Banshee
filmriseaction.us.description: Caleb, a former government assassin in hiding, resurfaces when his protégé, the equally deadly killer known as Banshee, discovers a bounty has been placed on Caleb's head. Now, they must put the past behind them and join together one last time to fight off the secret CIA-backed killers who threaten to destroy them. (Action, Drama) - 2022

filmriseaction.us.title: Derailed
filmriseaction.us.description: Secret agent Kristoff (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is assigned to escort Galina Konstantin (Laura Elena Harring), a thief in possession of a deadly virus, on a train journey that unluckily falls on his birthday. Kristoff tells his disappointed wife, son and daughter that he's taking a business trip. They decide to sneak aboard the train as a surprise, only to suspect he's having an affair with the mysterious Galina. To make matters much worse, terrorists hijack the train and go after the virus. (Action, Thriller) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: In Hell
filmriseaction.us.description: Kyle LeBlanc is an honorable citizen who winds up incarcerated in Russia after he takes revenge on the man who murdered his wife, resulting in the killer's death. Unfortunately for Kyle, he is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt and sadistic warden, the facility regularly holds brutal fights between inmates. In order to survive in the prison, Kyle must participate in the battles, even as he attempts to retain his humanity. (Action) - 2003

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Gunman

After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2015

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: My Baby Gone

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: 10th and Wolf

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Contract

Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Gerry

Initially, they maintain morale by rehashing old stories and reciting inside jokes, but the gravity of their situation sinks in as a return to civilization becomes more unlikely. As the sheer scope, hypnotic pull and spirit-crushing mirages of the desert affect the men, their will to live and sense of identity is challenged and transformed. (Drama) - 2002

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Animal Factory

Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid. fifthgear.us.description: S25 E03 Tiff Needell and Formula E driver Karun Chandhok race two supercar GTs worth over £400,000 between them, the Ferrari F12 and Aston Martin Vanquish; Jonny Smith looks at the ultimate British getaway car of the 1960s, the Mk2 Jaguar.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S25 E04 The team head to Warsaw; Tiff gets behind the wheel for the final stage of the Barborka Rally; Vicki test drives three extraordinary cars.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S25 E05 The team put the Ferrari 458 Speciale and the Porsche 911 GT3 to the test; Jonny Smith takes part in a challenge at the Ascari Circuit in Spain.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S25 E06 Rebecca and Tiff tackle the eccentric and muddy Exeter Trial; Jonny test drives the David Brown Speedback GT.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S26 E01 Tiff Needell and Vicki Butler-Henderson take part in a car vs. plane challenge; Nigel Lamb is the current Red Bull Air Race champion, which makes him the airborne equivalent of Lewis Hamilton.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S26 E02 Fifth Gear Tiff Needell visits northern Sweden for a very chilly rally challenge; he has just a few hours to learn the skills of racing on sheet ice before he takes on a rally champion over a treacherous rally stage.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S26 E03 Tiff Needell and Karun Chandhok take two high performance saloons to the track to discover which is the fastest, and most entertaining to drive.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S26 E04 Tiff Needell visits northern Sweden for a very chilly rally challenge; he has just a few hours to learn the skills of racing on sheet ice before he takes on a rally champion.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S26 E05 Fifth Gear re-unites two of the greatest names in Formula 1 history, Prost and Senna; this time it's Ayrton's nephew Bruno and Alain's son Nico who will do battle on the track.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S26 E06 Vicki Butler-Henderson and Tiff Needell travel to Romania to sample some of the car culture there; this includes driving some massive off-roaders, meeting a local classic car restorer and racing a motorsport mad Mayor up the streets of his town.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S27 E01 Jason and Tiff test two saloons against each other on the track, the Mercedes-AMG C63 S and Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio; guest star Ronnie O'Sullivan tests the DS 7 Crossback.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S27 E02 Kia's Test Facility Jonny Smith is granted access-all-areas to Kia's top secret test facility in the Californian desert where he investigates the lengths manufacturers go to in the quest for ever greater reliability.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S27 E03 Whose King of the Hot Hatches? Jason Plato is joined by former F1 driver Karun Chandhok to see who will be crowned king of the hot-hatches; the team tests the first Mercedes pick-up truck, the X-Class.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S27 E04 Caravan or Camper Van? The team tries out a range of new tests, new races and new motors from around the world; as well as meeting motoring legends, top supercars are put through their paces.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S27 E05 Two Mighty 4x4s Jonny Smith and Vicki Butler-Henderson go head-to-head as they review two 4x4 off-road vehicles; Vicki looks at some of the best deals to be found on SUVs.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S27 E06 Porsche 911 GT3 RS vs. Nissan GT-R Nismo Former Formula One driver Karun Chandhok returns to battle Jason Plato on the track in two of the most sought-after supercars, the Porsche 911 GT3 RS and the Nissan GT-R Nismo.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S27 E07 Jason and Karun Chandhok test four sports cars to find out which is the ultimate way to get some track day thrills; Vicki Butler-Henderson test-drives some second-hand hot hatches.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S27 E08 Ford Mustang and Chevrolet Camaro Tiff Needell and Jason take the new Ford Mustang and Chevrolet Camaro out on the track. The team tests Volvo's new V60 estate, to see if it rivals offerings from BMW and Mercedes.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S02 E08 Erotomania Martin urges Mrs. Tishell to remove the collar she's worn for years; career disagreements lead Louisa to break up with Danny; a man from the Salvation Army arrives in Portwenn.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E01 The Apple Doesn't Fall A new police officer, who has narcolepsy, replaces Mark Mylow; Martin treats a girl who's been taking her mother's diet pills.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E02 Movement Unhappy with his lot in life, Bert Large abandons his plumbing business to start his own restaurant, but the eatery's opening is followed immediately by several cases of food poisoning.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E04 The Admirer Louisa Glasson finds out she has a rival for Doc Martin's affections; Martin accidentally runs over a dog.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E05 The Holly Bears a Prickle Louisa ends her relationship with Martin, but when she needs him to treat her injured friend, he gets a chance to redeem himself.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E06 Nowt So Queer Portwenn is buzzing with news; Bert's restaurant is in trouble, so his son decides to take action to save the business.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S03 E07 Happily Ever After Martin needs to find a replacement vicar just three hours before the wedding; bridesmaid Isobel goes into labor.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E01 Better the Devil Martin prepares to leave Portwenn when his relationship with Louisa fails; Martin's medical school girlfriend arrives.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E02 Uneasy Lies the Head Martin is unsure what to do when he hears Louisa's news, but Louisa does not want him involved; Louisa's new headmaster is exhibiting erratic behavior.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E03 Perish Together as Fools Louisa has a medical scare and goes to Martin for reassurance; Joe Penhale's brother Sam comes to town; Martin learns the surgery needs some updating.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E04 Driving Mr. McLynn Martin urges Louisa to slow down after he catches her moving furniture; Martin refuses a handicapped parking tag for an elderly couple when the man won't prove he is disabled.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E05 The Departed The widow of one of Doc's patients believes her husband is trying to communicate from the grave; one of Louisa's students falls ill on a class trip.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E06 Midwife Crisis Doc clashes with the new district midwife over natural methods; Bert becomes enamored with a new restaurant employee.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E07 Do Not Disturb Pauline finds out Doc is leaving; Bert organizes a baby shower for Louisa; Doc and Edith go to a conference.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S04 E08 The Wrong Goodbye Bert has another money-making scheme go wrong on Doc's last day in Portwenn, causing Louisa to go into premature labor.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S05 E01 Preserve the Romance Martin Ellingham's plans to resume his career are put on hold with the birth of a baby; the new GP misdiagnoses a patient.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S05 E02 Dry Your Tears Doc Martin has to deal with the death of his Aunt Joan, demands of fatherhood, and the arrival of his Aunt Ruth.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S05 E03 Born With a Shotgun Martin's new receptionist makes a poor first impression; Louisa and Martin find sleepless nights are taking their toll.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S05 E04 Mother Knows Best Portwenn Fun Day has the villagers abuzz; Martin and Louisa are not happy when Louisa's mother arrives unexpectedly.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S05 E05 Remember Me Joe Penhale's amnesiac ex-wife visits; Louisa's mother may find romance; Martin and Louisa still need to name their baby.

filmrisebritishtv.us.title: Doc Martin
filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S05 E06 Don't Let Go Joe Penhale is desperate to show Maggie he has changed; Martin has to rescue Mr. Coley from a rooftop.

csi.us.title: CSI - Crash and Burn
csi.us.description: An elderly woman crashes her car into a crowded restaurant. One of the patrons is Sara's paramedic boyfriend. Grissom and Nick investigate the possible carbon monoxide murder of a woman in her home. (Drama, Crime Drama) - 20030313

csi.us.title: CSI - Precious Metal
csi.us.description: Catherine, Nick, and Sara investigate a seemingly months old body found in the mountains. (Drama, Crime Drama) - 20030403

csi.us.title: CSI - A Night At The Movies
csi.us.description: Grissom and Catherine investigate a movie-goer who was stabbed to death. (Drama, Crime Drama) - 20030410

csi.us.title: CSI - Last Laugh
csi.us.description: Grissom and Catherine investigate the murder of a despised comic who died onstage, apparently after drinking from a tainted bottle of water. (Drama, Crime Drama) - 20030424

csi.us.title: CSI - Forever
csi.us.description: The trampling death of a trainer by her horse aboard a private jet is investigated by Grissom, Catherine, and Nick. Sara and Warrick look into a Romeo and Juliet scenario in the desert. (Drama, Crime Drama) - 20030501

csi.us.title: CSI - Play With Fire
csi.us.description: Grissom, Sara, and Nick investigate the murder of a woman in the press box of a high school stadium. (Drama, Crime Drama) - 20030508

csi.us.title: CSI - Inside The Box
csi.us.description: A professional bank robbery leads to the death of a detective. While investigating the case, Grissom deals with his hearing loss and another CSI gets a personal revelation. (Drama, Crime Drama) - 20030515

csi.us.title: CSI - Bully For You
csi.us.description: Grissom and crew are called in after high roller Tony Braun, a known drug addict, is found dead in his house by a gardener. (Drama, Crime Drama) - 20010927

csi.us.title: CSI - Burked
csi.us.description: The entire CSI team investigates a disappearance at a local university. (Drama, Crime Drama) - 20011004

csi.us.title: CSI - Scuba Doobie-Doo
csi.us.description: Grissom investigates a possible suicide at a high-profile construction site. (Drama, Crime Drama) - 20011011

csi.us.title: CSI - Chaos Theory
csi.us.description: When the class clown at the local high school is found murdered, the CSI team is called to investigate. (Drama, Crime Drama) - 20011018

csi.us.title: CSI - Overload
csi.us.description: Grissom, Sara and Warrick are called in to investigate an abandoned, blood-splattered apartment and Nick and Catherine must examine a dead scuba diver lodged in a tree. (Drama, Crime Drama) - 20011025

csi.us.title: CSI - Alter Boys
csi.us.description: Grissom and his team investigate a murder suspect who is caught red-handed, burying the victims, while Catherine and Warrick take on the case of a woman found dead in a hotel spa. (Drama, Crime Drama) - 20011101

combatwarchannel.us.title: Battlezone WWII: The Gustav and Gothic Lines - Battle for Italy
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E04 Anzio An American artilleryman and a German foot soldier remember 1944's Battle of Anzio.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Nancy Wake: Gestapo's Most Wanted
combatwarchannel.us.description: Allied spy Nancy Wake is Great Britain's most decorated servicewoman during World War II -- and the Gestapo's most wanted woman.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Arnhem 1944: A Bridge Too Far Collection
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E03 Arnhem 1944 with Tom Hicks The Battle for control of Arnhem with exclusive interviews with veteran of the Battle Tom Hicks.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Hidden Side of World War II
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E01 D-Day A behind-the-scenes look at D-Day ranging from leaders' confidential decisions to the work of secret agents.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War 2 - The Call of Duty: A Complete Timeline
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E05 Fighting Further Afield (October - December 1940) Tracking the main events of WWII with the help of archive footage; learning about Pearl Harbor, The Battle of Britain, D-Day, the dropping of the atomic bomb, and more; from the early battles right through to the complexities of the endgame.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War 2 - The Call of Duty: A Complete Timeline
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E06 On Land, In the Air and All at Sea (January - March 1941) The Luftwaffe continues its attempts to bomb Britain into submission; the German Afrika Korps strengthens its position as Rommel, Hitler's "Desert Fox", takes charge; at sea, naval forces battle each other and the elements.

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWII In Color: From D-Day to Nazi Downfall
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E01 Overlord Germany braces for an Allied invasion, fortifying the Atlantic Wall with steel, concrete, and advanced weaponry.

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWII In Color: From D-Day to Nazi Downfall
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E23 And Justice for All With Berlin divided by the Allies, a new world emerges from the ashes.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Amazing World of War Machines
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E02 Rifles & Machine Guns Walter Hunt invents a "magazine" for loading of semi-automatic and automatic weapons.

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWII War Diaries
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E06 1944 Revisit the beginning of the end of World War II.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Desert Victory
combatwarchannel.us.description: British cameramen brave the front lines to document the Eighth Army's defeat of Rommel's forces in Africa.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Impossible Peace
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E02 1922-1925: Just Like The Arabian Nights After the failed Treaty of Versailles, America has rejected its president's peace settlement and withdrawn back into a position of isolation.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Annihilation - The Destruction of Europe's Jews
combatwarchannel.us.description: The Survivors When the Red Army arrived at Auschwitz, the Treblinka and Majdanek camps were almost empty, with only those too weak to be evacuated still there.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Soviet Storm
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E08 The Battle of Berlin The battle that ended the war.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Smashing Down the Reich
combatwarchannel.us.description: Exploring the destruction of the Nazi war machine; recounting significant events, including the Normandy landings, the battle of Paris, the last German offensive with the historical siege of Bastogne and the landing on the island of Elba.

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E09 Fateful Days In 1945, the Yalta Conference shapes the post-war world as the Allies assault Germany; Berlin falls, Hitler dies and the Nazis collapse; Europe's war ends, but the Pacific conflict rages on.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Annihilation - The Destruction of Europe's Jews
combatwarchannel.us.description: The Trap Cities in Germany and Austria remove Jews from the economy; this follows widespread property destruction; Germany then invades Poland; this military action begins the Second World War.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Fortress
combatwarchannel.us.description: A B-17 bomber's new commander faces a perilous mission.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Amazing World of War Machines
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E05 Tanks & Armored Vehicles The idea of tanks began as an extension of armory.

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And a Town Called Feud
electricnow.us.description: When a town's Civil War re-enactment is plagued by ghosts, the Librarians have to uncover the truth of what really happened there over 100 years ago. (Drama, Adventure) - 2018-01-17

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And Some Dude Named Jeff
electricnow.us.description: After switching bodies with a 28-year-old slacker named Jeff, Jenkins enlists the help of Jeff's hapless friends to find his way back into the Library to correct the mistake. (Drama, Adventure) - 2018-01-24

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Trial of the One
electricnow.us.description: It's time to choose the Librarian who will be tethered to Baird, but no one can decide, so the Library comes up with a trial during which the Librarians will be reduced to their most primal selves and abandoned in nightmarish landscapes. (Drama, Adventure) - 2018-01-31

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Echoes of Memory
electricnow.us.description: The world is morphed into an unrecognizable place where the library never existed; Baird brings the librarians together in an attempt to prevent the bleak, new world from becoming the new reality. (Drama, Adventure) - 2018-02-07

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Crown of King Arthur
electricnow.us.description: Someone is killing off potential Librarians, and it's up to Flynn Carsen and his new Guardian, Colonel Eve Baird, to save the three that are left. (Drama, Adventure) - 2014-12-07

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Sword in the Stone
electricnow.us.description: The Serpent Brotherhood is trying to return magic to the world; Flynn, Colonel Baird, and the potential Librarians must stop them before it's too late. (Drama, Adventure) - 2014-12-07

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Horns of a Dilemma
electricnow.us.description: The librarians' first solo mission hits a snag when Baird loses the others in a mysterious labyrinth that magically exists below the skyscraper of a modern corporation. (Drama, Adventure) - 2014-12-14

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And Santa's Midnight Run
electricnow.us.description: When the Serpent Brotherhood wants to kill Santa, the librarians must rescue him and help him accomplish the secret purpose of Christmas. (Holiday, Drama, Adventure) - 2014-12-21

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Apple of Discord
electricnow.us.description: When the dragons sleeping beneath the earth threaten to awaken and wreak havoc around the world, Flynn returns to help find their hidden treasure. (Drama, Adventure) - 2014-12-28

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Fables of Doom
electricnow.us.description: The Librarians travel to a town where fairy tales are coming to life and attacking! (Drama, Adventure) - 2015-01-04

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Rule of Three
electricnow.us.description: The librarians are forced to intercede when a group of competitive high school students start undercutting each other with witchcraft. (Drama, Adventure) - 2015-01-11

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - The Librarians and the Heart of Darkness
electricnow.us.description: The librarians encounter the house behind the legend of all haunted houses and set out to destroy it. (Drama, Adventure) - 2015-01-11

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the City of Light
electricnow.us.description: An investigation into a missing person uncovers what appears to be an alien invasion in a small town. (Drama, Adventure) - 2015-01-18

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Loom of Fate
electricnow.us.description: When Dulaque changes the course of fate, Baird begins moving through alternate timelines that reveal the changing destinies of the librarians. (Drama, Adventure) - 2015-01-18

electricnow.us.title: The Librarian: Quest for the Spear
electricnow.us.description: A caretaker beneath a metropolitan library protects magical artifacts from those who would use them to do evil. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2004

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Drowned Book
electricnow.us.description: Jenkins discovers there is something wrong with the library; the librarians are drawn together to solve the mystery of a massive storm that is parked over Manhattan. (Drama, Adventure) - 2015-11-01

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Broken Staff
electricnow.us.description: Prospero summons other fictionals in order to retrieve parts of his staff; the librarians find themselves pitted against Frankenstein's monster and Sherlock Holmes' nemesis Moriarty; Flynn and Baird have a disagreement. (Drama, Adventure) - 2015-11-01

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And What Lies Beneath the Stones
electricnow.us.description: Stone, Cassandra and Ezekiel team up to investigate a cave-in at an oil rig site which has unleashed a shape-shifting god who grows in strength when lies are told. (Drama, Adventure) - 2015-11-08

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Cost of Education
electricnow.us.description: When students begin disappearing at Wexler College, the librarians head out to investigate; Cassandra gets an offer that is difficult to turn down. (Drama, Adventure) - 2015-11-15

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Hollow Men
electricnow.us.description: Flynn is kidnapped by a mysterious stranger with both amnesia and a collection of the library's missing artifacts; the group pursues the Staff of Zarathustra. (Drama, Adventure) - 2015-11-22

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: America's Conspiracy Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. Each episode of this series investigates a compelling theory by opening these and other files. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. Just make sure you have your tin foil handy when watching the show. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Barn Find Firebird Rescue!
