(Episode, Series, Reality, Auto) - 20210824

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Road Trippin' the Wreck Runner!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Freiburger and Dulcich hit the road in the '68 Wreck Runner, a four-speed, 383ci clone made from the scraps of a '68 Road Runner and a '68 Satellite; it only has a few little issues; they hit the road to sort 'em out. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto) - 20210831

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Barnfind Firebird vs. Crusher Camaro!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Finnegan and Newbern take the barn-find '67 Firebird on an 800-mile road trip to race Freiburger and Dulcich in the Crusher Camaro. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto) - 20210907

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Roadkill - Dirt Track Rally Shootout!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Freiburger and Finnegan take on Dulcich and Newbern in a circle-track car shootout. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto) - 20210914

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - No-Prep Drag Race Mustangs!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The guys try their hand at no-prep drag racing against Lyle Barnett and his turbocharged 1,500-hp Beer Money Mustang. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20230920

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Two Legends Become One: Pigpen Lives!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: For years, Pigpen, the junkyard rescued 1950 GMC truck, has sat dormant; the guys awaken a monster by donating the chassis of their own legendary 1985 S-15 in a body swap for the ages, then take on Randy Pobst at Atlanta Motor Speedway. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20230927

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Everyone wants their car to be better, faster, stronger, but a difference is hard to make on a budget; David Newbern and Mike Cotten may not have all the answers, but they're willing to give it a run by mixing affordable upgrades with sweat equity. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20231004

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Crown Victorious: Cheap Racing Fun!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The guys uncover a cop car racing series around the Ford Crown Victoria P71 Police Interceptor; with a handful of bolt-on upgrades, they turn their former police auction find into a road race ripper around Willow Springs. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20231011

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Baja Bug V-8 Swap!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The guys take on off-road Baja legend Cameron Steele on a brutal desert off-road course with a Baja Bug; they may be outmatched by Cameron's unlimited racing rig, but the addition of a 350 V-8 to their Bug closes a big gap. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20231018

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Two Lifted Lambo Mud Truck!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The guys take their V-8-powered Pontiac Fiero-based Lamborghini Countach kit car known as the Scamborghini and give it a 6-foot lift to take on an insane wheelie-popping mud truck through what's known as a bounty hole. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20231025

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - '57 Chevy Two-Day Turnaround!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The guys take a big-block '57 Bel Air to compete in the autocross at Cruisin' the Coast in Miss.; with a complete overhaul of the suspension in the event's parking lot, the guys find out how much lap time they can shave in a weekend. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20240305

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - V-8 Baja Bug Suspension Overhaul!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Off-road legend Cameron Steele warned the guys that a V-8 swap wouldn't cut as much time as a long-travel suspension could; now Newbern and Cotten finally heed his advice, going all-out with major suspension upgrades to their Baja-inspired VW Beetle. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20240312

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Drag Racing Model A!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The guys take on Clay Millican by transforming a Model A from the ground up; with a new chassis, suspension and fresh 400-hp 347ci V-8, the Ford is improved in every way. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20240319

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Turbocharged Eagle Rally Racer!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Newbern and Cotten discover a gem which is not a typical American muscle with a turbocharged Eagle Talon; Shea Seefeldt challenges the guys on a rally course with his LS-swapped Subaru. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20240326

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Monte Carlo Circle Track Surprise
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Newbern surprises Cotten with a mint 1984 G-body and an '80s-style, stock-car-inspired build to take on an actual former cup car around the circle track. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20240402

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten - Pro Street Mirada Makeover!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Cotten's Pro Street big-block 1980 Dodge Mirada's engine dies on Roadkill; things don't go as planned as the guys attempt to add a giant blower and bigger tires, and bring the car back to its 1990s-era glory. (Episode, Series, Auto) - 20240409

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Finnegan - Funny Car Dirt Drags!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The guys transform a '73 Opel funny car into a dirt-roosting machine. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto) - 20220614

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Finnegan - Vette Kart vs. 700hp Pro2 Truck!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The dream of long travel suspension on Roadkill's slightly modified Vette Kart finally comes true for the guys; Brad DeBerti helps them figure out how to not taco the front end as they take on a Pro2 truck on an off-road short course. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto) - 20220621

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Finnegan - Waterless Boat Racing!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Newbern, Cotten, and Finnegan participate in an unusual race that requires their boat to survive the competitors' attacks on a dirt track. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto) - 20220628

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Finnegan - Drift Pinto: Ford vs. Ferrari!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Newbern and Cotten surprise Finnegan with a 2.3L 1980 Pinto wagon and drift lessons from pro Formula Drift driver Federico Sceriffo; they add a 396ci stroker engine and suspension mods before taking on a 1,000-plus-hp Ferrari 599 GTB. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto) - 20220705

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Finnegan - Motorhome Wheelies!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Finnegan, Newbern and Cotten do some wheelie R&D to find out what it takes to put a 1978 GMC Class C motorhome's tires in the air; with the help of pro wheelstander Mike Mantel, the guys take on the challenge of making dreams become reality. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto) - 20220712

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Faster With Finnegan - Wheelie Motorhome vs. Little Red Firetruck!
motortrendfasttv.us.description: The 1978 GMC motorhome takes on Mike Mantel's Little Red Firetruck. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto) - 20220719

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Iron Resurrection - Thundering C10
motortrendfasttv.us.description: It takes a lot to faze Joe Martin, but when his next job pulls into MSB it looks more like a truck load of spare parts than a 1970 C10; Joe knows exactly what he wants to do; new frame, running gear, and a supercharged LSA engine. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto, Motorcycle) - 20180904

motortrendfasttv.us.title: Iron Resurrection - El Chili
motortrendfasttv.us.description: Gary Hopper, a longtime friend of Joe, brings a '55 Chevy Bel Air to the shop; because this '55 has sentimental value to Gary's family, the pressure is on to do this build right; but missing pieces and a dented hood throw a wrench into the job. (Episode, Series, Reality, Auto, Motorcycle) - 20180904

moviesphere.us.title: Bangkok Dangerous
moviesphere.us.description: Remorseless assassin Joe (Nicolas Cage) is in Thailand to complete a series of contract killings for a crime boss called Surat (Nirattisai Kaljaruek). He hires a street punk named Kong (Shahkrit Yamnam) to run errands for him, all the while planning to kill the youth at the conclusion of his assignment. Instead, Joe becomes Kong's unlikely mentor,and begins a tentative romance with a local shop girl. But as Joe begins to let his guard down, Surat decides it is time to clean house. (Action, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2008-08-22

moviesphere.us.title: Bad Moms
moviesphere.us.description: Amy (Mila Kunis) has a great husband, overachieving children, beautiful home and successful career. Unfortunately, she's also overworked, exhausted and ready to snap. Fed up, she joins forces with two other stressed-out mothers (Kristen Bell, Kathryn Hahn) to get away from daily life and conventional responsibilities. As the gals go wild with their newfound freedom, they set themselves up for the ultimate showdown with PTA queen bee Gwendolyn and her clique of seemingly perfect moms. (Comedy, Movie) - 2016-07-28

moviesphere.us.title: I Feel Pretty
moviesphere.us.description: An ordinary woman who struggles with feelings of insecurity and inadequacy on a daily basis wakes from a fall believing she is suddenly the most beautiful and capable woman on the planet. With this newfound confidence, she is empowered to live her life fearlessly and flawlessly, but what will happen when she realizes her appearance never changed? (Comedy, Movie, Romance) - 2018-04-05

moviesphere.us.title: Silver Linings Playbook
moviesphere.us.description: After losing his job and wife, and spending time in a mental institution, Pat Solatano winds up living with his parents. He wants to rebuild his life and reunite with his wife, but his parents would be happy if he just shared their obsession with the Philadelphia Eagles. Things get complicated when Pat meets Tiffany, who offers to help him reconnect with his wife, if he will do something very important for her in exchange. (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Romance) - 2012-11-16

moviesphere.us.title: The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent
moviesphere.us.description: Unfulfilled and facing financial ruin, actor Nick Cage accepts a $1 million offer to attend a wealthy fan's birthday party. Things take a wildly unexpected turn when a CIA operative recruits Cage for an unusual mission. Taking on the role of a lifetime, he soon finds himself channeling his most iconic and beloved characters to save himself and his loved ones. (Action, Comedy, Movie) - 2022-03-12

moviesphere.us.title: The Blackening
moviesphere.us.description: A group of old college friends reunite for a Juneteenth weekend getaway, only to find themselves trapped in a remote cabin with a twisted killer. Forced to play by his rules, they soon realize this isn't a game. (Comedy, Horror, Movie) - 2022-09-16

moviesphere.us.title: The House Next Door: Meet the Blacks 2
moviesphere.us.description: After surviving a night of terror on the West Coast, author Carl Black moves his family back to his childhood home in Chicago. His quest to find peace and quiet takes an unexpected turn when he meets the eccentric new homeowner next door. Convinced that the man is a vampire, Carl and his oddball neighbors join forces to save themselves from the bloodsucking undead. (Action, Comedy, Horror, Movie) - 2021-06-11

moviesphere.us.title: American Psycho
moviesphere.us.description: In New York City in 1987, a handsome, young urban professional, Patrick Bateman (Christian Bale), lives a second life as a gruesome serial killer by night. The cast is filled by the detective (Willem Dafoe), the fiancé (Reese Witherspoon), the mistress (Samantha Mathis), the coworker (Jared Leto), and the secretary (Chloë Sevigny). This is a biting, wry comedy examining the elements that make a man a monster. (Dark comedy, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2000-01-21

moviesphere.us.title: Warm Bodies
moviesphere.us.description: A terrible plague has left the planet's population divided between zombies and humans. An unusual zombie named R (Nicholas Hoult) sees his walking-dead brethren attacking a living woman named Julie (Teresa Palmer) and rescues her. Julie sees that R is different from the other zombies, and the pair embark on an unusual relationship. As their bond grows and R becomes more and more human, a chain of events unfolds that could transform the entire lifeless world. (Horror, Movie, Romantic comedy, Thriller) - 2013-02-01

moviesphere.us.title: Borderlands
moviesphere.us.description: Returning to her home planet Pandora, an infamous bounty hunter forms an unexpected alliance with a ragtag team of misfits. Together, they battle alien monsters and dangerous bandits to uncover one of Pandora's most explosive secrets. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Movie, Science fiction) - 2024-08-07

outlaw.us.title: Many Rivers to Cross
outlaw.us.description: Headstrong Mary Stuart Cherne (Eleanor Parker) is in hot pursuit of frontiersman Bushrod Gentry (Robert Taylor), and is determined to make him her husband. Naturally, Bushrod has no desire to leave the happy, wandering life of a trapper. He heads north to escape Mary's nuptial advances. But with hostile Shawnee Indians at every turn, Bushrod and Mary must set aside their differences and work together to survive the wilds of the unfamiliar territory. (Western, Comedy) - 1955

outlaw.us.title: Colt .45
outlaw.us.description: While gun purveyor Steve Farrell (Randolph Scott) shows off the latest revolver innovation, a Colt .45 repeating handgun, to Sheriff Harris (Alan Hale), outlaw prisoner Jason Brett (Zachary Scott) grabs a pair and hightails it out of town -- and the sheriff jails Farrell as a likely partner in crime. But during Farrell's incarceration, Brett goes on an unstoppable rampage. Farrell is released, and must stop the outlaw with the assistance of Walking Bear (Chief Thundercloud) and the Colt .45. (Western) - 1950

outlaw.us.title: Thunder Over the Plains
outlaw.us.description: It's the late 1860s, and the U.S. government has yet to reclaim Texas as a state. A group of opportunistic and amoral Northerners head south to claim the territory as their own. Though Texas lawman Capt. Porter (Randolph Scott) believes it's his duty to honor the local leaders, he can't ignore the corruption of the Yankee politicians who are giving him orders. When Confederate veteran Ben (Charles McGraw) is unjustly sentenced to death, Porter decides he has had enough of his new bosses. (Western) - 1953

outlaw.us.title: Kansas Pacific
outlaw.us.description: With the American Civil War looming, construction of the Pacific railroad is being held up in Kansas, sabotaged by Confederate sympathizers. The government dispatches an Army engineer, John Nelson (Sterling Hayden), to oversee construction, and he initially rubs the wrong way both his proud boss (Barton MacLane) and his boss's feisty daughter (Eve Miller). Eventually, though, both fall for Nelson's charms, and the hero seeks to uncover the Southern rat so he can lead the Union men due west. (Western) - 1953

outlaw.us.title: Advance to the Rear
outlaw.us.description: As punishment for their incompetence in battle, disgraced Union soldier Capt. Jared Heath (Glenn Ford) and his apathetic commanding officer, Col. Claude Brackenbury (Melvyn Douglas), are reassigned away from the front lines. The hapless Heath and Brackenbury must now lead a ragtag group on a classified mission to protect a transport for the U.S. Treasury. Complicating matters is Martha Lou Williams (Stella Stevens), a Confederate agent posing as a lady of the evening. (Western, Comedy) - 1964

outlaw.us.title: Wyatt Earp
outlaw.us.description: The epic biography of western lawman Wyatt Earp, who at an early age, is taught that nothing matters more than family and the law. He becomes a respected sheriff in Dodge City and Tombstone. Joined by his brothers and Doc Holliday, Earp wages war on the dreaded Clanton and McLaury gangs. (Biography) - 1994

outlaw.us.title: Jeremiah Johnson
outlaw.us.description: A Mexican-American War veteran, Jeremiah Johnson (Robert Redford), heads to the mountains to live in isolation. Woefully unequipped for the task at hand, Johnson is fortunate to come across a seasoned mountain man (Will Geer) willing to teach him the necessary survival tactics. As life continues in the mountains, Johnson finds himself a native bride (Delle Bolton) and an adopted son (Josh Albee). However, their peaceful existence is threatened when Johnson incurs the ire of the Crow Indians. (Adventure) - 1972

outlaw.us.title: The Big Sky
outlaw.us.description: In 1830, two tough Kentucky mountaineers join a trading expedition from St. Louis up the Missouri River to trade whisky for furs with the Blackfoot Indians. They soon discover that there is much more than the elements to contend with. Based on the novel by AB Guthrie, Jr. (Adventure) - 1952

outtvproud.us.title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre Part 2
outtvproud.us.description: Chainsaw-wielding maniac Leatherface (Bill Johnson) is up to his cannibalistic ways once again, along with the rest of his twisted clan, including the equally disturbed Chop-Top (Bill Moseley). This time, the masked killer has set his sights on pretty disc jockey Vanita Stretch Brock (Caroline Williams), who teams up with Texas lawman Lefty Enright (Dennis Hopper) to battle the psychopath and his family deep within their lair, a macabre abandoned amusement park. (Horror, Dark comedy) - 1986

outtvproud.us.title: Heretic
outtvproud.us.description: A diabolical Mr. Reed ensnares two young missionaries in a terrifying game of cat and mouse when they knock on the wrong door and are forced to prove their faith. (Thriller, Horror) - 2024

outtvproud.us.title: All the Boys Love Mandy Lane
outtvproud.us.description: Beautiful Mandy Lane (Amber Heard) isn't a party girl but, when classmate Chloe (Whitney Able) invites the Texas high school student to a bash in the countryside, she reluctantly accepts. After hitching a ride with a vaguely scary older man (Anson Mount), the teens arrive at their destination. Partying ensues, and Mandy's close pal, Emmet (Michael Welch), keeps a watchful eye on the young males making a play for Mandy. Then two of the students are murdered. (Horror, Thriller) - 2006

outtvproud.us.title: Frankenstein
outtvproud.us.description: In this re-imagining of Mary Shelley's classic, Dr. Frankenstein is Dr. Victor Helios (Thomas Kretschmann), who has found the means to prolong his life into the present. Portrayed as the villain, Helios has amassed a collection of monsters that are killing people in New Orleans. Detectives Carson O'Connor (Parker Posey) and Michael Sloane (Adam Goldberg) team with the doctor's first creation, Deucalion (Vincent Perez), to track down and stop the crazed evil scientist. (Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 2004

outtvproud.us.title: Taboo
outtvproud.us.description: An unknown killer stalks six friends one year after they played a provocative parlor game. (Thriller, Horror) - 2002

outtvproud.us.title: Bitch Slap
outtvproud.us.description: Three bad girls, a stripper, a drug-runner, and a power broker, arrive in the desert to extort money from an underworld kingpin, but things quickly spin out of control as allegiances change. (Action) - 2009

outtvproud.us.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
outtvproud.us.description: Mother Nature (Saoirse Ronan) loves to cause mischief, and she steps in to help two love-starved souls find happiness. She helps an aging professional woman (Michelle Pfeiffer) who has no luck with love find her match with a much younger man (Paul Rudd). As their relationship blossoms into something beyond physical attraction, her adolescent daughter (Tracey Ullman) begins to question the tingling sensations she experiences whenever she is in the company of a handsome local boy. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 2007

outtvproud.us.title: Warm Bodies
outtvproud.us.description: A terrible plague has left the planet's population divided between zombies and humans. An unusual zombie named R (Nicholas Hoult) sees his walking-dead brethren attacking a living woman named Julie (Teresa Palmer) and rescues her. Julie sees that R is different from the other zombies, and the pair embark on an unusual relationship. As their bond grows and R becomes more and more human, a chain of events unfolds that could transform the entire lifeless world. (Romantic comedy, Horror, Thriller) - 2013

outtvproud.us.title: From Prada to Nada
outtvproud.us.description: Spoiled sisters Nora (Camilla Belle) and Mary (Alexa Vega) Dominguez have a life of wealth and privilege in Beverly Hills. However, their world crashes when their father dies suddenly. Now penniless, the two have to move in with their Aunt Aurelia (Adriana Barraza) in East L.A.'s Boyle Heights. Striving to work through the culture clash, Nora and Mary begin to embrace their Latin heritage, discover romance, and learn the meaning of family. (Comedy, Romantic comedy, Action, Drama) - 2011

outtvproud.us.title: Unlikely Angel
outtvproud.us.description: A dead country singer (Dolly Parton) seeks to get into heaven by uniting a troubled family during the holidays. (Holiday, Drama) - 1996

outtvproud.us.title: Elvira's Haunted Hills

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E26 Property Brothers: Jessie & Joe With twin toddlers, ex-marine Joe and Jessie outgrew their cramped Nashville condo before they moved in. And now the search is on for a farmhouse-style home where they'll have plenty of room to grow.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E15 Property Brothers - Amanda & Tre Tre and Amanda have been living in a rental for nearly three years, and as the kids get bigger their temporary home is getting smaller. They're ready to find a place of their own and are determined to stay in their exclusive lakefront community.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E01 Property Brothers: Tyler and Lindsay Tyler and Lindsay love their waterfront lifestyle, but desperately need a family home where they can put down roots. Drew and Jonathan help them find a property in their exclusive neighborhood with minimal compromise.

tastemadehome.us.title: Property Brothers
tastemadehome.us.description: S06 E17 Property Brothers - Rave & Michelle Along with their two little ones, Rave and Michelle are staying with his parents while hunting for the perfect suburban home. And though they're a close-knit family, living under one roof is proving too close for comfort.

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E13 A Villa Escape With Classic Charm Darren and Meg are relocating from the East Coast. They're looking for better weather year round. They're visiting some of the most desirable properties in Pasadena, California. The want California living with character and a modern twist.

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E06 House Hunting For An Entrepreneur HQ Tyler is leaving Los Angeles to expand his business. He's visiting some of the most desirable properties in Silicon Valley, California. Will he find his dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E11 Designing A New Life By The Beach Arica, a designer, and Sean, a contractor, are relocating from San Francisco. They're visiting some of the most desirable properties in Orange County, California. It's important for them to be closer to the beach and have space for their future dogs.

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E03 The Educators' Dream Castle Michael and Lynne are looking for a new home for when they get married. They're visiting some of the most desirable properties in Pacific Palisades, California. Will they find their dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E09 From City Streets to Ocean Breeze Doug and Nicole are searching for a new luxury home in Los Angeles, California. They need a house that's closer to their clients and to the beach. Will they find their dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E04 The Ultimate Home for Art Lovers George and Bill are looking to cut their commute and move to the city. They're visiting some of the most desirable properties in Palo Alto, California. Will they find their dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E03 A Tuscan Escape We meet Alex who is on the lookout for his forever home. Viviana is taking him through some of the most beautiful properties in Santa Barbara, California.

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E04 An Entertainers Dream Today we meet Mish who is on the lookout for her forever home. She is looking for a home perfect for entertaining. But will Viviana be able to find her a place that fits her style?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E08 Trading The East For A West Coast Dream Home Selena is looking to move closer to Silicon Valley from the East Coast life that she's been living. She's visiting some of the most desirable properties in Saratoga, California. Will she find her dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E11 Full Throttle Dream Homes We meet Steven. He is looking for a place to spend his weekends that will accommodate his love of Motor Sports. Viviana is taking him through some of the most desirable properties in this one-of-a-kind Motor Sports Country Club.

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E05 Work From Home Meets Garden Goals Gea and David are looking for more space for indoor offices and outdoor entertaining. They're visiting some of the most desirable properties in Cupertino, California. Will they find their dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E12 A Yoga Haven By The Sea Serena is leaving Seattle for life on the beach. She wants to bring her yoga business to California and live in a home where she can have her yoga studio. She's visiting some of the most desirable properties in Manhattan Beach, California.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E02 Family of Five Funhouse Love is large, but space is tight for Lara & Mike and their 5 children. Brian and Sarah free up space by building an activity-packed tree house and recreation court for the children, with grilling, dining and lounging areas for the whole family.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E12 Communal Gathering Space H and her tenant Emma are bursting out of their 3-unit home. To help out both landlord and tenants, Brian and Sarah add storage space, plus a common lounge space in the backyard, with some urban inspired design touches.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E02 Nana's Wonderland Janet's love for her nine grandkids is endless. But so is the chaos they bring inside her home when they come visit. To take that energy outside, Brian and Sarah build a fun kid-zone in the backyard, but also a sophisticated adult area for Janet.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E04 Treehouse Village Debbie, Kevin, and their three children are a newly-blended family. To bring this new family together, Brian and Sarah build an irresistible treehouse village in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E08 D.J.'s Den Cool parents, Michelle and Adrian, are passionate about music and events. Brian and Sarah tune into their needs and amp up their boring backyard with a DJ den, a creative arts-and-crafts wall, and hang-out zones for family jam sessions.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E07 Luxury Staycation Since having two kids, Sonia and Peter have resorted to staycations at home, but their backyard is a headache. Brian and Sarah create a luxury vacation destination that includes a pool, spa, outdoor kitchen and a stunning four-season structure.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E14 Modern Woodshop Newlyweds Cheryl and Gavin love their new home, but Cheryl doesn't love the sound of Gavin's woodworking in the garage. Brian and Sarah help by building a dedicated wood shop and some chic new living space in their urban backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E05 Sports Bar Craig and Claudia share their new space with Craig's brother, Craig's parents - and their two massive dogs. To give these new homeowners a place of their own, Brian and Sarah build a sports bar and entertainment hangout in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E10 Greenhouse Bliss Lynna is a single mom with three teenage kids and the time has come for her to have the back garden of her dreams. Brian and Sarah deliver in spades, with a 3 season hang-out, lush new landscaping, and a beautiful greenhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E08 Pooch Party Pavillion Carly & Nate's social media star dog, Dean the Basset Hound, has a lot of four-legged friends visiting, leaving the home feeling cramped. Brian and Sarah make a bar/lounge for pet and owner gatherings, along with a stylish outdoor entertainment area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E04 Stained Glass Studio Couple Farzana & Reyan have maxed out all living space in their city-sized bungalow, leaving no room for Reyan's at-home stained-glass business or Farzana's writing. Brian and Sarah build Reyan a spacious studio and construct an inspiring deck area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E03 Kids Clubhouse Ali and Hana have two very talented young children - and a very noisy and crowded house. To give everyone in this family their own space, Brian and Sarah turn an old garage into a kids' music and arts hangout.

tastemadehome.us.title: World's Most Secret Hotels
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E01 Extreme Escapes Explore some unique and unusual hotels in Cambodia, Italy, Wales, Sweden and England - from jungle retreats to converted caves.

tastemadehome.us.title: World's Most Secret Hotels
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E02 Remote Hideaways Explore some unique and unusual hotels in Jordan, England, Sweden, and Ecuador — from a desert resort that resembles a colony on Mars to a hotel in the clouds.

tastemadehome.us.title: World's Most Secret Hotels
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E03 Hidden Escapes Explore some unique and unusual hotels in the USA, Finland, Canada and Scotland — from a hotel hidden within one of New York's busiest airport runways to a winter wonderland in the Arctic Circle.

tastemadehome.us.title: World's Most Secret Hotels
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E04 Invisible Hideaways Explore some unique and unusual hotels in Uruguay, Sweden, Scotland, Oman and the Netherlands—from a camouflaged fort-like resort perched on the edge of a mountain to mainland Britain's most isolated hotel.

tastemadehome.us.title: World's Most Secret Hotels
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E05 Hilltop Escapes In search of unique and unusual hotels, travel to the Scottish wilderness, the Welsh mountains, a tower in Greece with a deadly history, and a hotel perched on a glacier in Italy.

shadesofblack.us.title: Soul Men
shadesofblack.us.description: Louis (Samuel L. Jackson) and Floyd (Bernie Mac) used to be one of the country's top musical duos, until they broke up and never spoke again. Old animosities resurface 20 years later when the two are thrust together on a cross-country trip to take part in a tribute concert honoring their late band leader. Louis and Floyd have just five short days to bury the hatchet -- hopefully not in someone's head -- before they take the stage at New York's Apollo Theater. (Comedy) - 2008

shadesofblack.us.title: The Last Letter
shadesofblack.us.description: Catherine Wright struggles with a debilitating sleep disorder. Her husband Michael struggles to cope when their newborn son lies awake. (Thriller) - 2012

shadesofblack.us.title: Original Gangstas
shadesofblack.us.description: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence. (Action) - 1996

shadesofblack.us.title: Shottas
shadesofblack.us.description: Deported from the United States, two drug dealers (Ky-Mani Marley, Spragga Benz) travel to Miami and continue their violent ways. (Crime drama) - 2002

shadesofblack.us.title: Reggie Yates' Extreme South Africa - The Millionaire Preacher
shadesofblack.us.description: Reggie Yates gets up close and personal with three very different communities in South Africa, exploring what life is like for the people living here. (Documentary, Travel) - 2014-03-03

shadesofblack.us.title: State Property
shadesofblack.us.description: Frustrated with being broke, "Beans" (Beanie Sigel) decides that the only way to grasp the American Dream is to take it. "State Property" follows Beans and his crew, the ABM as they take over the city, creating mayhem as their empire builds. Beans now struggles to maintain his family life, while bumping heads with opposing gangsters and the police. It all comes to a head when he cannot surpass the city's most notorious crew run by Untouchable J (Jay-Z) and Dame (Damon Dash). (Crime drama) - 2002

shadesofblack.us.title: State Property 2
shadesofblack.us.description: The gang war in Philadelphia is mostly centered around two rivals: Dame, the ruthless leader of the Umbrella organization, whose money and firepower have put him at the top of the crime world; and Beans, the one-time crime overlord hell-bent on taking back the city. The wild card is El Pollo Loco, a new player on the scene. His strategy involves teaming up with one side against the other -- but in reality, Loco has no plans to share Philadelphia with anyone. (Crime drama) - 2005

shadesofblack.us.title: American Violet
shadesofblack.us.description: After an overzealous district attorney's drug bust lands her in jail, single mother Dee Roberts (Nicole Beharie) must face an agonizing choice: Plead guilty and go home a convicted felon, or fight the charges and risk a lengthy prison sentence. Despite her mother's (Alfre Woodard) advice and risking everything, innocent Dee chooses to fight the Texas criminal justice system, joined by an ACLU attorney (Tim Blake Nelson) and a former narcotics cop (Will Patton). (Drama) - 2008

shadesofblack.us.title: Crash
shadesofblack.us.description: Writer-director Paul Haggis interweaves several connected stories about race, class, family and gender in Los Angeles in the aftermath of 9/11. Characters include a district attorney (Brendan Fraser) and his casually prejudiced wife (Sandra Bullock), dating police detectives Graham (Don Cheadle) and Ria (Jennifer Esposito), a victimized Middle Eastern store owner and a wealthy African-American couple (Terrence Dashon Howard, Thandie Newton) humiliated by a racist traffic cop (Matt Dillon). (Drama) - 2004

shadesofblack.us.title: Final Shot: The Hank Gathers Story
shadesofblack.us.description: Inspired by his mother (Nell Carter) and a priest (George Kennedy) in Philadelphia, he (Victor Love) rises to basketball All-American at Loyola Marymount. (Biography) - 1992

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - What Happens in Vegas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon wants to show Fred & Gino that the food and fresh produce are off the charts! In Las Vegas they indulge in one of the most expensive beef burgers. After a night at the casino they're on the road again to experience the real wild west. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - San Fran Summer of Love
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gino & Fred are excited to head to San Francisco for their very own Summer of Love. Gordon tries to embrace the flower power mood, but he's more interested in the 61 Michelin Stars. The boys travel to a Napa Valley vineyard in a hot air balloon. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Brokeback Mountain
tastemadetravel.us.description: After four weeks on the road, Gino's airing his feet in the back seat as the guys cruise along a Texan highway. Texas is a meat lover's paradise, and Gordon is keen to show the Europhiles some of the best BBQ known to man. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Go Greek! Clash of the Titans
tastemadetravel.us.description: The boys are in the Greek capital Athens in a vintage VW campervan. This is where high-concept cuisine originated and is still being re-invented, in a city known as the birthplace of democracy and the cradle of western civilisation. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Desperately Seeking Santa
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred are getting together for another extraordinary culinary Christmas adventure. Gordon arranged a trip to the official home of Santa. They are going to Lapland to enjoy spectacular landscapes and meet Father Christmas in person. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Highland Fling
tastemadetravel.us.description: The trio heads to Scotland as Gordon prepares to cook a feast for the chief of Clan Ramsay and his friends. Gordon shows the others how to dress like real Scotsmen as they go in search of Scottish beef, hunt for scallops and play some Highland Games. (Cooking, Travel) - 2025-09-05

tastemadetravel.us.description: Top chefs in England take Fred Sirieix to experience amazing restaurants where they genuinely love to eat. (Travel, Cooking, Documentary) - 2024-04-10

tastemadetravel.us.title: Extraordinary Places to Eat - The Master Pasta Maker of Puglia, Italy
tastemadetravel.us.description: TV and radio host Dermot O'Leary takes Fred Sirieix to Puglia in Italy's deep South to his favourite restaurants showcasing simple but sublime cucina povera or poor man's cooking. (Travel, Cooking, Documentary) - 2024-01-23

tastemadetravel.us.title: Extraordinary Places to Eat - Searching for the Best Pizza in Rome, Italy
tastemadetravel.us.description: Chef Giorgio Locatelli takes Fred to Rome in search of the city's most exciting eats. Sublime pasta, fluffy gnocchi and the world's best pizza all delicious but affordable. (Travel, Cooking, Documentary) - 2024-02-07

tastemadetravel.us.title: Extraordinary Places to Eat - The Floating Restaurant of Devon, United Kingdom
tastemadetravel.us.description: Fred travels to South Devon with chef and restaurateur Angela Hartnett. From Angela's all-time favourite restaurant in Dartmouth to an incredible floating café on the River Exe. (Travel, Cooking, Documentary) - 2024-02-14

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Best Tacos In Mérida
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati explores the streets of Yucatán's capital, Mérida. She tries the best tacos in Mérida at Wayan'e. The aroma of freshly made cookies lures her to Dondé Fabric, where their globitos and bizcochitos are an important part of Mérida's mornings. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Sonoran Family Favorites
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati spends a day in the kitchen with her middle son, Sami, cooking recipes inspired by her travels in Sonora that she knows he'll love - beef and potato chimichangas, rice with lentils and caramelized onions, and an avocado and radish salad. (Cooking) - 2024-02-08

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Legends of the Sonoran Sea
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati travels to Sonora's coast on the Sea of Cortez, where local legend Toño Contreras gives her a tour including shellfish on the beach, his restaurant Mariscos El Rey, and his home kitchen for some crave-worthy recipes. (Cooking) - 2024-02-15

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Super Sonoran
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati makes three classic Sonoran recipes: a fish special called pescado zarandeado, a rich stew called gallina pinta and a tasty dirty rice with clams. In Sonora, she visits vacation destination Puerto Peñasco. (Cooking) - 2024-02-15

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Secret Family Recipies in Ho Chi Minh
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke searches to find Ho Chi Minh's old markets before they disappear due to District 1's rapid development. Join Luke as he gathers fresh ingredients from a local market, tries some traditional delicacies, and follows his sweet tooth to Marou. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-02-04

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Vietnamese Pizza in Dalat
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke's next stop is the destination of Dalat. Follow Luke as he visits the Art Deco Dalat Train Station, experiences the French influence of the region with a father and son chef duo, and discovers why Dalat is known as the "Land of Eternal Spring"! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-02-17

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Exploring The 'Wet Market' Of Nha Trang
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang—a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes! (Cooking) - 2020-02-24

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Fiery Chili Sauce in Hoi An
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke is in the town of Hội An. He visits a family who has been making chili sauce for 5 generations, stops by the Historic Japanese Covered Bridge built in 1719, and meets a 4th generation blacksmith who is creating knives from bombshells. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-03

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Loaded Dogs & Classic Cocktails in San Diego
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie Celenza heads to San Diego to sample a modern spin on classic deli fare, heavily loaded low-riding hot dogs, frosty & fruity Taiwanese snow ice, and fancy French cocktails from a rotating carousel bar. (Cooking, Travel) - 2023-10-05

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Pierogies, Bagels, and Ramen in NYC
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie Celenza takes a LOT of bites out of the big apple as he samples warm pillowy bagels & schmear, grabs pierogies at an old school Ukrainian spot, gets the scoop on innovative ice cream flavors, and slurps up some real ramen. (Cooking, Travel) - 2023-10-12

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Salmon Tacos, Meatballs, & Perogies in Las Vegas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie dazzles in Las Vegas where he enjoys crunchy salmon skin tacos, an homage to after-school snacks, and the dish that put Martha Stewart on the map. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Cooking for the Crew
tastemadetravel.us.description: As Pati travels with her TV production crew through Mexico, they stop at a hacienda outside of Hermosillo where Pati prepares a true Sonoran feast in the rustic outdoor kitchen - Sonora cheese soup, chicken in pecan and ancho chile sauce. (Cooking) - 2024-02-22

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Nectar of the Mayan Gods
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Yucatán's Most Unique Salts
tastemadetravel.us.description: An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced. (Cooking)

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E04 Newton: Framing, Wiring, and an Unfitted Kitchen Removing the temporary support beam holding up the back corner of the house; new framing materials used in the new kitchen; removing the old kitchen walls and installing a new 16-foot beam to open up the space; unsafe conditions and code violations.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S14 E25 Hidden Door; Hydrant Tom heads to Salem, Mass., to install a bookshelf that doubles as a hidden doorway; Scott Caron explains how two tools are all he needs to do many electrical projects; Richard installs a house hydrant to replace a leaky outdoor spigot.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S14 E26 Doorbell; Home Gym Tom and Kevin head to Montana to build an accessible home gym for a Navy SEAL who was injured in Afghanistan; master electrician Scott Caron helps a homeowner replace a broken doorbell chime; Richard explains PVC pipe terminology.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S15 E01 Windows; Robotic Mower Tom replaces sash balancers on an antique window; Roger and Kevin check out the benefits of a robotic lawnmower; Richard talks about treating water with lead.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S15 E02 Fire Safety; Strainer Kevin visits Chicago to explore the dangers of home fires and ways to stay safe; Scott shows Kevin a battery-powered generator that can provide electricity; the guys look at a gray, rubber handle; Richard finds a rusted sink strainer in the kitchen.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E01 Newton: Move or Improve? Reviewing the "new" house: the good news-an exterior in pretty good shape and beautiful intact woodwork-and the bad news-some structural issues and a disconnected, sorely outdated kitchen; extensive plaster damage; bathrooms in need of updating.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E02 Newton: Big Plans Landscape architect Stephanie Hubbard's plan for major work in the back to re-grade and create a large new patio; Norm Abram and homeowner Paul Friedberg begin demolition; in the basement, Kevin learns how to loosen a stuck sewer cap.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E03 Newton: Prepwork and Inspiration Prepping the footings for the new porch columns; civil engineer Mike Kosmo does the perc test; a stunning neighborhood shingle-style house; removing a rotted red maple from the side yard with a tree crew and crane.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E04 Newton: Framing, Wiring, and an Unfitted Kitchen Removing the temporary support beam holding up the back corner of the house; new framing materials used in the new kitchen; removing the old kitchen walls and installing a new 16-foot beam to open up the space; unsafe conditions and code violations.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S07 E26 Bathroom Vent Fan; Organic Lawn Care Kevin O'Connor and an electrician help a homeowner install a new ventilation fan in her bathroom; What Is It?; Roger shows a pair of homeowners how to care for their lawn without using chemicals or pesticides.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S07 E27 Drain Trap; Floating Floor Richard Trethewey helps a homeowner repair a leaking PVC drain trap underneath his kitchen sink; Tom helps a pair of homeowners install a new bamboo floating floor in their basement; a viewer tip on how to clean roof gutters without a ladder.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S08 E01 Fire Pit; Microwave Oven Install Landscaping contractor Roger Cook helps a homeowner build a cozy campfire pit in her backyard; What Is It?; Tom helps a homeowner install a combination range hood and microwave oven over her kitchen stove top.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S08 E02 Home Intercom; Fireplace Insert Kevin teams up with an electrician to install a home intercom system; What Is It?; Richard helps a homeowner make a wood-burning fireplace cleaner and more energy-efficient by installing a gas-burning insert.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S08 E03 Urban Backyard; Fiber-Cement Cutting Tools Landscaping contractor Roger Cook travels to Baltimore to help transform a small urban backyard into a pleasant outdoor living space; Tom shows Kevin some new ways to install fiber cement siding without creating a lot of dust.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S08 E04 Gutter Install; Efficient Washer/Dryer Installing new aluminum gutters and downspouts; What is it?; Richard helps a homeowner install a new energy-efficient clothes washer and dryer.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S08 E05 Sliding Glass Door Install General contractor Tom Silva helps a pair of homeowners install a new sliding glass door; Tom, along with host Kevin O'Connor, landscaping contractor Roger Cook and plumbing and heating expert Richard Trethewey ask, What is it?

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S08 E06 Container Garden; Flooring; TV Antenna Roger Cook joins plant expert Carrie Kelly at a nursery to learn about container gardening; different types of flooring, including solid wood, engineered wood, ceramic tile, vinyl, and linoleum; helping a homeowner install a new rooftop TV antenna.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S08 E07 Weatherstripping; Heating System Sizing Helping a homeowner seal out drafts by installing weather-stripping on her front door; several ways to monitor and save electricity; helping a homeowner determine the proper size for a heating system by performing a comprehensive heat-loss analysis.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S08 E08 Picnic Table; Utility Sink General contractor Tom Silva and host Kevin O'Connor head outside the barn to build a basic picnic table using common framing lumber; What is it?; Richard helps a homeowner install a new utility sink in a basement laundry area.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S47 E23 Walpole ADU: Retro Vibes Installing vinyl siding on the main house and ADU; revealing the ADU's framed layout; reviewing basement HVAC; installing a three-panel slider to connect indoor and outdoor living.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S47 E24 Walpole Walpole ADU: An Attic ADU Touring a new attic apartment ADU in Dorchester, Mass.; plumbing update.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S47 E25 Walpole ADU: Board & Batten Down the Hatches Visiting a factory that makes engineered plank flooring; installing some board and batten wall paneling in the new mudroom.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S47 E26 Walpole ADU: A Double Homecoming Touring a renovated ranch and brand-new ADU, reviewing shared systems and exterior plans while exploring how the new spaces function for the family.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E01 Newton: Move or Improve? Reviewing the "new" house: the good news-an exterior in pretty good shape and beautiful intact woodwork-and the bad news-some structural issues and a disconnected, sorely outdated kitchen; extensive plaster damage; bathrooms in need of updating.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E02 Newton: Big Plans Landscape architect Stephanie Hubbard's plan for major work in the back to re-grade and create a large new patio; Norm Abram and homeowner Paul Friedberg begin demolition; in the basement, Kevin learns how to loosen a stuck sewer cap.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E03 Newton: Prepwork and Inspiration Prepping the footings for the new porch columns; civil engineer Mike Kosmo does the perc test; a stunning neighborhood shingle-style house; removing a rotted red maple from the side yard with a tree crew and crane.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E04 Newton: Framing, Wiring, and an Unfitted Kitchen Removing the temporary support beam holding up the back corner of the house; new framing materials used in the new kitchen; removing the old kitchen walls and installing a new 16-foot beam to open up the space; unsafe conditions and code violations.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E05 Newton: Retaining Wall, Historic Wallcovering Roger installs 200 feet of pre-cast concrete to create a retaining wall; Richard Nylander helps Kevin date and evaluate the historic wallpaper; Tom frames a new window; Harvard Law School construction project.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E06 Newton: Exterior Paint Colors, Stained-Glass Window Kevin O'Connor learns what colors might be appropriate for the Shingle-style house; building the 12-foot wall of the new kitchen bump out that will contain a built-in bench; restoration of the home's four historic windows.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E07 Newton: Salvage, Progress, and Pink Granite Progress on the porch, kitchen, and master bath; installing new windows; update on the mechanical systems; Treff LaFleche takes Kevin to see how the pink granite was used on the Boston Public Library; Roger installs the new Milford Pink granite.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E08 Newton: Fieldstone, Replacement Windows, and Teak Roger digs up a large, established shrub by the front walkway to be transplanted in the backyard and shows Kevin how work on the new fieldstone sitting wall is progressing; a replacement window; radiant heat panels under the entry hall.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E09 Newton: Pests, Decking, and AC Roger Cook is building the fieldstone and mortar sitting wall; treatment to stop the termite activity; Tom Silva shows a new dowel fastening system; Richard shows high velocity mini-duct systems feeding air to the lower floors.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S09 E08 Storm Door; Soldering; Privet Hedge Install a new energy-efficient storm door; Richard Trethewey shows host Kevin O'Connor how to cut and solder copper plumbing pipes and fittings; landscaping contractor Roger Cook helps a homeowner reduce the size of an overgrown privet hedge.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S09 E09 Patio Repair, Rusty Bulkhead Landscaping contractor Roger Cook helps a homeowner repair an uneven stone patio; Roger, Kevin, Tom Silva, and Richard Trethewey ask What is it; Kevin and painting contractor Mauro Henrique help a homeowner repaint a rusty metal bulkhead door.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S09 E10 Radiant Heat; Drywall Corners; Wheelbarrows Helping a homeowner heat his newly remodeled kitchen by installing hot water radiant tubing underneath the floor; What Is It?; Tom shows Kevin how to apply joint compound to drywall corners; lessons on using a wheelbarrow properly.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S09 E11 Stair Runner Repair; Digging Tools; Recessed Lights Tom helps an old friend repair the loose carpeting on his staircase; Roger shows Kevin several different types of shovels and other tools for digging; in Pasadena, Calif., Kevin and a local electrician install recessed lights in a kitchen ceiling.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S09 E12 Energy-Efficient HVAC; Oak-Floor Patch Richard Trethewey helps a pair of homeowners reduce the utility bills by installing a new forced-air furnace and air conditioning system; Tom Silva helps a homeowner repair damage to her oak flooring that was caused by a leaky radiator.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S09 E13 Chainsaws; Gutter Repair; Bathtub Install Roger and chainsaw expert Tim Ard demonstrate safe chainsaw use and a brand-new way to sharpen chains; Tom helps a homeowner with a leaky rain gutter; What is it?; Richard and Kevin install a new fiberglass bathtub and shower enclosure.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S09 E14 Bathroom Sink; Concrete Wall Richard Trethewey helps a homeowner install a second sink into an existing bathroom vanity; Roger Cook shares a viewer tip that makes yard clean-up a little easier; Tom Silva helps a homeowner repair a large crack in his concrete block foundation.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S09 E15 Lawn Mowing; Deck Building Roger and Kevin do some yard clean-up using rakes, blowers and lawn vacuums; Richard shows how HVAC thermostat technology has evolved over the years; Tom installs carpet tiles over a concrete floor.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S09 E16 Deck Building, Deck Fasteners General contractor Tom Silva helps two homeowners complete the construction of their new backyard deck; back in the workshop, Tom shows host Kevin O'Connor a few other types of hidden deck-fastening systems.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Nation
tinyhousenation.us.description: S04 E11 320 Sq. Ft. Tiny Arc David and Conrad are ready to make the move to go tiny, just before they make another move down south to Central Florida.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Nation
tinyhousenation.us.description: S05 E01 Tiny Forever After John and Zack take on a rescue mission in Atlanta for Peter and Elizabeth, a couple who are struggling to finish construction on their own tiny house, are about to get married, and plan to change jobs and move to Maine all in a month's time.

truehistory.us.title: Books That Matter: The Analects of Confucius - The Analects: A Bird's-Eye View
truehistory.us.description: The "Analects" should not just be read, but lived; how to enter the book's world by considering Confucius's imaginative ideas about living in society; practicing one's ability to navigate through the book's tangle of information and questions. (Books & literature) - 2016-12-09

truehistory.us.title: Books That Matter: The Analects of Confucius - The Man We Call Confucius
truehistory.us.description: Who Confucius is; how he manages to become one of the most important figures in world history; what historians know about Confucius; the opinions of thinkers like Mencius and Xunzi; several illuminating passages from Chapter 10 of the "Analects". (Books & literature) - 2016-12-09

truehistory.us.title: Books That Matter: The Analects of Confucius - How the Analects Is Organized
truehistory.us.description: The structure of the "Analects" offers a helpful way to understand the text's deeper meanings: breaking down Confucius's book into its chapters, the scattered nature of its tiny nuggets of knowledge, and the generations of historical commentary. (Books & literature) - 2016-12-09

truehistory.us.title: Introduction to Paleontology - History on a Geological Scale
truehistory.us.description: Taking a virtual walk from the Washington Monument to the U.S. Capitol to explore the 4.54 billion-year history of Earth, with each stride representing 1 to 2 million years; along the way, fossils paint a picture of life on Earth from its start. (Science) - 2016-11-11

truehistory.us.title: Introduction to Paleontology - Life Cast in Ancient Stone
truehistory.us.description: Learning about those whose curiosity about the Earth and its fossils leads to the development of the science of paleontology; studying the geographic, climatic and chemical requirements for a living organism to leave behind its fossilized record. (Science) - 2016-11-11

truehistory.us.title: Introduction to Paleontology - Tools of the Paleontological Trade
truehistory.us.description: In addition to the basic mechanical tools still used in the field today, paleontologists have an exciting digital tool chest; dispersive x-ray spectroscopy and x-ray computer tomography and their use to examine fossils of varying sizes and shapes. (Science) - 2016-11-11

truehistory.us.title: Introduction to Paleontology - How Do You Fossilize Behavior?
truehistory.us.description: While the fossilized remains of some organisms are rarely found, the evidence of their existence, as they interacted with the environment, exists; learning how trace fossils help understand the early evolution of the biosphere and animal life. (Science) - 2016-11-11

truehistory.us.title: Herodotus: The Father of History - Herodotus and History
truehistory.us.description: Identifying key issues of definition and terminology; explaining what is known about the life of Herodotus; background on the ancient Greek world; summarizing the momentous events, particularly the Persian Wars, that spur Herodotus to write. (Educational) - 2002-03-11

truehistory.us.title: Herodotus: The Father of History - \"Inquiry\" and the Birth of History
truehistory.us.description: Herodotus is not the first Greek to write about the past; knowing makes him original; how he explains, in the very first sentence of his work and one that richly rewards close reading, the what, why and how of his monumental effort. (Educational) - 2002-03-11

truehistory.us.title: Herodotus: The Father of History - Myth, Legend, and Oral Tradition
truehistory.us.description: Knowing how Herodotus deals with the vast and complicated body of traditional narratives that inform the Greek world; how his subject and his angle on it both resemble and differ from older accounts of the ways and causes of things. (Educational) - 2002-03-11

truehistory.us.title: Herodotus: The Father of History - Homeric Epic and the East-West Conflict
truehistory.us.description: For all ancient Greeks, Homer is a pervasive influence; Herodotus models his work on the "Iliad" and the "Odyssey," yet he departs from the Homeric and gives the uniquely Herodotean perspective. (Educational) - 2002-03-11

truehistory.us.title: The Darwinian Revolution - The Meaning of Evolution
truehistory.us.description: Pondering why Darwin is so revolutionary; his breakthrough is not in introducing the idea of evolution, which has long been debated, but in proposing how evolution occurs; surveying these and other themes that are developed in the course. (Educational, Science, History) - 2008-12-17

truehistory.us.title: The Darwinian Revolution - The Way It Used to Be
truehistory.us.description: Examining the traditional worldview in the West, which is based on the biblical account of creation fixed at 4004 B.C.; an allied idea is the Great Chain of Being, pictured as an immutable scale of life forms from the most primitive to God himself. (Educational, Science, History) - 2008-12-17

truehistory.us.title: The Darwinian Revolution - Theories of Evolution in the 18th Century
truehistory.us.description: Studying three 18th-century thinkers; Benoit de Maillet, who estimates the age of the cosmos; Georges Buffon, who believes living things descend from more primal forms; Pierre Simon Laplace, who proposes a theory for the solar system's formation. (Educational, Science, History) - 2008-12-17

truehistory.us.title: The Darwinian Revolution - Fossils and Catastrophism
truehistory.us.description: At the end of the 18th century, fossils are not necessarily regarded as actual remains of living things; they become central to the work of Georges Cuvier, who connects them to extinct species which he believes died out in violent catastrophes. (Educational, Science, History) - 2008-12-17

truehistory.us.title: Books That Matter: The Analects of Confucius - The Hidden Teaching Dynamic of the Analects
truehistory.us.description: Getting a broader view of Confucius and his style of teaching; examining how the text's performative nature holds its diverse teachings together; exploring Confucius's mission to return China to a more harmonious era in its history. (Books & literature) - 2016-12-09

truehistory.us.description: Getting a broader view of Confucius and his style of teaching; examining how the text's performative nature holds its diverse teachings together; exploring Confucius's mission to return China to a more harmonious era in its history. (Books & literature) - 2016-12-09

truehistory.us.title: Books That Matter: The Analects of Confucius - The Analects: A Bird's-Eye View
truehistory.us.description: The "Analects" should not just be read, but lived; how to enter the book's world by considering Confucius's imaginative ideas about living in society; practicing one's ability to navigate through the book's tangle of information and questions. (Books & literature) - 2016-12-09

truehistory.us.title: Books That Matter: The Analects of Confucius - The Man We Call Confucius
truehistory.us.description: Who Confucius is; how he manages to become one of the most important figures in world history; what historians know about Confucius; the opinions of thinkers like Mencius and Xunzi; several illuminating passages from Chapter 10 of the "Analects". (Books & literature) - 2016-12-09

truehistory.us.title: Books That Matter: The Analects of Confucius - How the Analects Is Organized
truehistory.us.description: The structure of the "Analects" offers a helpful way to understand the text's deeper meanings: breaking down Confucius's book into its chapters, the scattered nature of its tiny nuggets of knowledge, and the generations of historical commentary. (Books & literature) - 2016-12-09

truehistory.us.title: Introduction to Paleontology - History on a Geological Scale

truehistory.us.title: Introduction to Paleontology - Life Cast in Ancient Stone

truehistory.us.title: Introduction to Paleontology - Tools of the Paleontological Trade

truehistory.us.title: Introduction to Paleontology - How Do You Fossilize Behavior?
truehistory.us.description: While the fossilized remains of some organisms are rarely found, the evidence of their existence, as they interacted with the environment, exists; learning how trace fossils help understand the early evolution of the biosphere and animal life. (Science) - 2016-11-11

truehistory.us.title: History's Great Military Blunders and the Lessons They Teach - Petersburg: Union Digs Its Own Grave - 1864
truehistory.us.description: Following the chain of events that led to the Civil War's ill-fated Battle of the Crater; what can happen in warfare when a plan goes awry due to various factors; the phenomenon of military blunders and what they can teach people. (World history) - 2015-09-25

truehistory.us.title: History's Great Military Blunders and the Lessons They Teach - Syracuse: Athens's Second Front - 413 B.C.
truehistory.us.description: From initiating a second front with a new enemy to dividing supreme command among multiple generals; how failures of decision-making and leadership spelled disaster for the Greek city state of Athens in the outcome of the Peloponnesian War. (World history) - 2015-09-25

classica.us.title: Antonio Manna: Il basso napolitano
classica.us.description: Stefano Demicheli dirigiert das Ensemble Talenti Vulcanici und die Solisten Nicola Cianncio und Catherine Jones in einem abwechslungsreichen Programm aus Barockmusik, aufgenommen in der Chiesa di Santa Caterina da Siena in Neapel, Italien. (Special, Music) - 2021-07-13

classica.us.title: Misha Enzovoort
classica.us.description: Für Misha Mengelberg hat das Vergessen begonnen. Er wartet auf ein Taxi, das er nicht gerufen hat, um zu einem Konzert zu fahren, das nicht stattfindet. Der niederländische Komponist, Pianist und Meister des Jazz Misha Mengelberg, geboren 1935, taucht immer tiefer in das Dunkel der Demenz, die sein Musikerleben beendet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2017-05-19

classica.us.title: Heyward dirigiert Dvořáks Sinfonie Nr. 9
classica.us.description: Es ist eins der beliebtesten Stücke aller Zeiten: Mit der Aufführung von der 9. Sinfonie e-Moll unter dem Namen "Aus der Neuen Welt" von Antonín Dvořáks gibt der amerikanische Dirigent Jonathon Heyward mit dem "London Symphony Orchestra" sein Debüt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-10-04

classica.us.title: Schostakowitsch - Concertino für zwei Klaviere
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmet sich die argentinische Pianistin Martha Argerich dem Repertoire für Klavier und Violine in diesem wunderbaren Konzert, das im Château de Chantilly in Frankreich aufgezeichnet wurde. (Special, Music) - 2025-05-31

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Danielpour - Elegies
classica.us.description: Hartmut Haenchen leitet das Orchester der Philharmonie zuidnederland in einem Konzert von Richard Danielpours "Elegies". Solisten sind Marina Prudenskaya und Thomas Oliemans. Die Aufnahme entstand 2019 im Muziekgebouw Eindhoven in den Niederlanden. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2020-04-04

classica.us.title: Mozart - Sinfonie Nr. 34, K. 338
classica.us.description: Der Maestro Iván Fischer dirigiert das Orchester del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in einem fesselnden Konzertprogramm mit Werken von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart und Antonín Dvořák. Eröffnet wird das Programm mit Mozarts Sinfonie Nr. 34 in C-Dur. (Special, Event) - 2025-06-04

classica.us.title: House of Dreams
classica.us.description: Ein fantasievolles Konzert führt mit barocker Musik auf eine magische, musikalische Reise. Das Ensemble des Tafelmusik Barock Orchester hat sich auf historische Performances spezialisiert. Ihre Musik trifft auf barocke Kunst. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2019-11-08

classica.us.title: Liszt - Zwei sinfonische Dichtungen
classica.us.description: Franz Liszt verfasste 13 sinfonische Dichtungen, die von literarischen Texten inspiriert waren. Der Komponist schrieb Klavier-Duette für diese Dichtungen, die sein beeindruckendes Talent zeigten, ein volles Orchester mit nur einem Piano zu imitieren. (Special, Music) - 2025-08-15

classica.us.title: Ginandrea Noseda
classica.us.description: Dieser Dokumentarfilm berichtet über den italienischen Dirigenten Gianandrea Noseda. (Special, Music, Documentary) - 2017-08-24

classica.us.title: Schumann - Sinfonische Etüden, op. 13
classica.us.description: In dieser Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwarz Schumanns Symphonische Etüden op. 13. Das zwischen 1834 und 1837 komponierte Werk bestand zunächst aus einem Thema und einer Reihe von sechzehn Variationen. Es wurde von Baron von Fricken komponiert. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2024-01-16

classica.us.title: In der Probe: - Mariss Jansons
classica.us.description: Mariss Jansons probt mit dem Oslo Philharmonischen Orchester die kraftvolle Suite aus Béla Bartóks Pantomimenballett "Der wunderbare Mandarin", gefolgt von einer Aufführung des gleichen Stücks aus dem Konzerthaus von Oslo. (Music) - 2000-04-23

classica.us.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise für zwei Klaviere Op. 77
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags spielt Martha Argerich Saint-Saëns Polonaise für Klavier Op. 77. Das Konzert wurde im Château de Chantilly, Frankreich, aufgezeichnet. Die Pianistin wird von verschiedenen renommierten Künstlern begleitet. (Special, Music) - 2025-06-01

classica.us.title: Tschaikowski - Violinkonzert, op. 35
classica.us.description: Simone Lamsma spielt mit dem London Symphony Orchestra unter der Leitung von Gianandrea Noseda Pjotr Tschaikowskis Violinkonzert in D-Dur. Bei diesem Konzert aus der Londoner Barbican Hall entfacht Lamsma ein virtuoses Feuer. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-11-01

classica.us.title: Klavierduette - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff u. a
classica.us.description: In diesem prächtigen Konzert vereinen sich zwei außergewöhnliche russische Pianisten, Nikolay Lugansky und Vadim Rudenko. Diese Aufführung wurde am 25. November 2021 in der Tschaikowski-Konzerthalle in Moskau, Russland, aufgezeichnet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-05-17

classica.us.title: Schumann - Novelletten, op. 21
classica.us.description: In dieser Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwartz Schumanns Novelletten, Op. 21. Die acht Stücke für Klavier, die diesen Liederzyklus ausmachen, werden oft einzeln aufgeführt. Es trägt eine Widmung an den Pianisten Adolph Henselt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-01-23

classica.us.title: Liszts 1. Klavierkonzert & Mahlers 5. Sinfonie
classica.us.description: Michael Tilson Thomas dirigiert das London Symphony Orchestra in einer Aufführung von Franz Liszts Klavierkonzert Nr. 1 in Es-Dur und Gustav Mahlers Sinfonie Nr. 5. Der tschechische Pianist Lukáš Vondráček ist der Solist in Liszts Konzert. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-12-13

classica.us.title: Bach - 3. Brandenburgisches Konzert
classica.us.description: J. S. Bachs sechs Brandenburgische Konzerte gehören zu seinen bekanntesten Werken. Bei dieser Aufführung im Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses präsentieren Luks und sein Collegium 1704 Bachs brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 3 in G-Dur. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-06-11

classica.us.title: Liszt Mosaics- II
classica.us.description: Das Konzert lässt außer Werken von Liszt einige Stücke der ungarischen Nationalromantik erklingen, die Liszt als Inspiration dienten. Daneben sind Kompositionen von den Zeitgenossen Paganini und Chopin zu hören, die Liszt beeinflussten. (Family, Special, Music) - 2021-04-24

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Streichquartette Nr. 2, 14 und 16
classica.us.description: Das Quatuor Ébène präsentiert in der Philharmonie de Paris Meisterwerke aus Beethovens Streichquartettrepertoire. Zum Jubiläum des Komponisten spielt das renommierte französische Ensemble die Streichquartette Nr. 2, 14 und 16. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-10-05

classica.us.title: Veerhavenconcert 2016
classica.us.description: Das Veerhavenconcert ist eine jährliche Veranstaltung im Hafen von Rotterdam. Diese Aufnahme stammt vom 27. August 2016. Es spielt die Sinfonia Rotterdam unter der Leitung von Conrad van Alphen. Solisten sind dieses Mal Maria Warenberg (Mezzosopran) und Melle de Vries (Cello). Auf einer schwimmenden Bühne zeigen Spitzenmusiker dem Publikum auf den Booten im Hafen oder auf dem Kai, was sie können. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert)

classica.us.title: Chopin - Polonaise-Fantasie, op. 61
classica.us.description: Die in der Ukraine geborene Pianistin Inna Faliks spielt Frederic Chopins Polonaise-Fantasie Op. 61. Aufgenommen in der Nicols Konzert Hall in Evanston. Faliks hat sich als eine der poetischsten Künstlerinnen ihrer Generation etabliert. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-08-11

classica.us.title: Ravel - Ma mère l'Oye
classica.us.description: Die Pianistin Martha Argerich spielt mit vielen Stars der klassischen Musik Ravels "Ma mère l'Oye". Das Konzert wird zugunsten des Erasmus-Fonds für medizinische Intensivpflegeforschung organisiert und dem Cellisten Aleksandr Khramouchin gewidmet. (Special, Music, Concert) - 2024-11-08

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Sinfonie Nr. 2 in D-Dur, op. 36
classica.us.description: Philippe Jordan dirigiert das Orchester de l'Opéra national de Paris in Beethovens Symphonie Nr. 2. Gespielt wird die Symphonie in D-Dur Op. 36, welche zum ersten Mal am 3. abcentertains.au.title: Ninjago - The Forgotten Element
abcentertains.au.description: After stealing the remaining contestant's powers, Chen only needs Lloyd's power to complete the spell and knowing his daughter has feelings for Kai, Chen tries to enlist the Fire Ninja by promising to share secrets. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Shaun The Sheep: Brain Breaks - Lost In Space
abcentertains.au.description: Calling all space cadets: there's a sheep lost in space and he needs YOU to guide him through the galaxy! Dodge flying objects and scary black holes so Shaun can make his way back to planet Earth. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Alphablocks - Star
abcentertains.au.description: A STAR invites the Alphablocks to follow it on a BROOM. They take off on two BROOMS, encounter a STORM, and ride into the heart of the Northern Lights in the BRIGHT night sky.

abcentertains.au.title: Colourblocks - Yellow
abcentertains.au.description: Yellow is happy to bring his colour to Colourland. Learn about the colour yellow with the Colourblocks. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Numberblocks - Double Back
abcentertains.au.description: It's time for a time-travel adventure! Sixty-four's new time machine keeps sending the Numberblocks back in time - can they double up in time to fix it? Learn about doubling with the Numberblocks. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: One, Two, Threebies! - A MAZE-ing!
abcentertains.au.description: Roh has made a tricky maze! Boxy and Tri must learn about directions to reach the other side.

abcentertains.au.title: Super Why's Comic Book Adventures - In a Jam!
abcentertains.au.description: Alpha Pig accidentally makes a giant jam blob that starts oozing through Reader Valley! (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Dance With Tom - Mungera - Gumtree
abcentertains.au.description: Tom teaches a Mungera dance. Mungera is the Yugambeh word for Gumtree. The Gumtree is home to many birds and animals and keeps them safe. Join Tom in a Mungera dance to be strong and remember to feel good protecting others!

abcentertains.au.title: Maddie's Do You Know? - How Is It Made? Whistle
abcentertains.au.description: Maddie heads to a whistle factory to see how they are made. She sees big, strong stamping machines cut shapes out of brass and finds out how the cork ball gets put inside.

abcentertains.au.title: Wordsville - The Case Of The Persuasive Person
abcentertains.au.description: The recipe card for Baker Graham's PERSUASION pie has been snatched and now no one is able to persuade anyone in Wordsville to do anything!

abcentertains.au.title: The Brilliant World Of Tom Gates - Parents Evening
abcentertains.au.description: Tom is set some homework on a day off from school. Bad news! Luckily the homework is a drawing project. Good news! Tom shows us how to make a pencil holder. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: My Place - 1798 Sam
abcentertains.au.description: Sam, a child convict, is working for a man who's never there. He's on his own in the bush and in charge of a villainous goat. When the goat disappears Sam spends a night in the scary bush to get her back. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Media Stamped - Hearing is Believing
abcentertains.au.description: What song was playing under the last video you watched? Science shows that music can manipulate your feelings - even when you can hardly hear it! If you watch videos all day long, you're listening to them too.

abcentertains.au.title: Hey You What If? - You Switched off the Sun?
